articles.title: Structured Sentiment Analysis Using Sequence Labeling as Dependency Graph Parsing
articles.abstract: This study addresses the problem of structured sentiment analysis, whose goal is to obtain a fine-grained sentiment graph where the nodes represent spans of sentiment holders, targets, and expressions, while the arcs define the relationships among them. Our proposed approach casts the task as dependency graph parsing, but departs from traditional parsing methods by solving it through sequence labeling. To do so, we leverage recent advances in linearized graph encodings that allow each word in the input to be assigned a label, effectively capturing the structure of the dependency graph. We conducted experiments on seven datasets spanning five languages (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, and Catalan), showing performance competitive with leading, more complex single-model approaches.
articles.titleCn: 基于序列标注的依存图解析的结构化情感分析
articles.abstractCn: 本研究针对结构化情感分析问题，其目标是从文本中构建细粒度的情感图谱，其中节点代表情感持有者、目标和表达，而边则定义了它们之间的关系。我们提出的方法将任务转化为依存图解析，但与传统解析方法不同，通过序列标注来解决。为此，我们利用了线性化图编码的最新进展，使得输入中的每个词可以被分配一个标签，从而有效地捕捉依存图的结构。我们在涵盖五种语言（英语、西班牙语、挪威语、巴斯克语和加泰罗尼亚语）的七个数据集上进行了实验，结果表明我们的方法在性能上与更复杂、更单一模型的领先方法具有竞争力。

articles.title: TRACE: Diagnosing Verifier Brittleness in Agentic Evaluation
articles.abstract: Verifier scores now serve as both benchmark metrics and training rewards for large language model (LLM) agents, and a change in score is routinely read as a change in capability. It may instead reflect a change in the evaluation. We introduce TRACE, a protocol that turns a score change from a verdict into a testable diagnosis: it applies a targeted change to one part of an evaluation, compares paired runs, checks whether the agent's behavior changed, and rescores unchanged trajectories to test whether the scoring rule is responsible. In a controlled suite of 25 synthetic tasks, renaming tools lowers a scripted agent's score by 0.250 even though it performs exactly the same operations; restoring the original names at scoring time closes the entire gap, while the same mutation exposes a genuine behavioral failure in a second agent. On public $τ^2$-bench tasks with four LLM agents, an initial 30-task study finds mixed reward changes whose one clear effect does not replicate. In a larger follow-up on 88 new tasks with repeated runs per condition, renaming tools or reformatting tool outputs leaves reward unchanged to within $\pm$0.10 for seven of eight agent-change pairs, whereas tool names that deliberately mislead lower every agent's reward by 0.20-0.44, showing that the setup can detect real effects. Identical reruns flip 15-36% of task outcomes, so single-run comparisons cannot separate presentation effects from run-to-run variation. Two frontier LLM judges give consistent verdicts when a fixed trajectory is presented differently, yet disagree with each other on 57% of the same records, largely because one grades procedure rather than outcome. TRACE thus separates what a score change says about the agent from what it says about the measurement.
articles.titleCn: TRACE：诊断智能体评估中验证器的脆弱性
articles.abstractCn: 验证分数现在既作为大型语言模型（LLM）代理的基准指标，也作为训练奖励，分数的变化被常规地解读为能力的改变。但它可能反映的是评估方式的变化。我们引入了TRACE协议，将一个判决中的分数变化转化为可测试的诊断：它对评估的一部分进行定向改变，比较配对的运行结果，检查代理的行为是否改变，并对未改变的轨迹重新评分以测试评分规则是否负责。在一个包含25个合成任务的受控套件中，重命名工具会降低脚本代理的分数0.250，尽管它执行的操作完全相同；在评分时恢复原始名称则完全弥补了分数差距，而相同的变异在第二个代理中暴露了真正的行为缺陷。在包含四个LLM代理的公开$τ^2$-基准任务上，一项初始的30任务研究发现了混合的奖励变化，其唯一明确的效果无法复制。在一个更大规模的后续研究中，对88个新任务进行重复条件运行，重命名工具或重新格式化工具输出对八个代理变化对中的七个的奖励影响在±0.10以内，而故意误导的工具名称则降低了每个代理的奖励0.20-0.44，表明该设置可以检测真实效果。相同的重运行会翻转15-36%的任务结果，因此单次运行比较无法区分呈现效应与运行间变异。当固定轨迹以不同方式呈现时，两个前沿LLM裁判给出一致的判决，但在57%的相同记录上相互分歧，主要是因为其中一个裁判更注重过程而非结果。因此，TRACE将分数变化对代理的影响与对测量的影响分离开来。

articles.title: DIAL-OPD: Learning More from Fewer Tokens in On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated trajectories with token-level teacher signals. Its sampled-token variant avoids the cost of full-vocabulary probabilities. Yet we find that training on fewer tokens can outperform full-token OPD, challenging the intuition that more supervision improves learning. This motivates selecting tokens by learning value. Existing disagreement-based criteria ignore probability scale: tokens assigned negligible probability by both models, termed low-low tokens, can receive large log-ratio rewards and hinder learning. We propose DIAL-OPD, a token-selection method that bridges log-probability and probability spaces by weighting reward magnitude with the logarithmic mean of teacher and student probabilities. A parameter beta controls this weighting, and the highest-scoring tokens are retained. Across 4 teacher-student pairs and 7 mathematical reasoning benchmarks, we compare DIAL-OPD with 9 baselines. Retaining only 40% of tokens, it outperforms Vanilla OPD and its full-token variants, with mean accuracy gains reaching 5.25 percentage points over Vanilla OPD, and doubles AIME25 Pass@16 from 13.33% to 26.67%. It also achieves up to an 18% relative improvement in mean accuracy over the strongest token-selection baseline at matched retention ratios. With a 4B teacher, DIAL-OPD surpasses the strongest full-token baseline using an 8B teacher at both student scales, showing that effective supervision allocation can outweigh teacher scaling. Further analysis shows that moderate beta balances suppressing low-low tokens against preserving useful disagreements. Token-level evidence reveals that DIAL-OPD filters high-reward tokens with limited reasoning value while preserving supervision critical to reasoning correctness.
articles.titleCn: DIAL-OPD：在策略蒸馏中从更少的符号中学习更多
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）通过标记级别的教师信号监督学生生成的轨迹。其采样标记变体避免了全词汇概率的成本。然而我们发现，使用较少的标记进行训练可以优于全标记OPD，挑战了更多监督能提升学习的直觉。这促使我们通过学习价值来选择标记。现有的基于分歧的标准忽略了概率尺度：被两个模型都分配了极小概率的标记，称为低低标记，它们可能会获得较大的对数比奖励并阻碍学习。我们提出了DIAL-OPD，这是一种通过将对数概率和概率空间进行加权的方式来选择标记的方法，权重为教师和学生学习概率的对数平均值。参数beta控制这种加权，保留得分最高的标记。在4对教师-学生和7个数学推理基准测试中，我们将DIAL-OPD与9个基线进行了比较。仅保留40%的标记时，它优于Vanilla OPD及其全标记变体，平均准确率提升达到5.25个百分点，将AIME25 Pass@16从13.33%提高到26.67%。在匹配的保留率下，它比最强的标记选择基线在平均准确率上提高了高达18%。使用4B教师时，DIAL-OPD在学生规模上超过了使用8B教师的 strongest 全标记基线，表明有效的监督分配可以超过教师规模。进一步分析表明，适度的beta在抑制低低标记和保留有用的分歧之间取得了平衡。标记级别的证据显示，DIAL-OPD过滤了具有有限推理价值的高奖励标记，同时保留了对推理正确性至关重要的监督。

articles.title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
articles.abstract: Improving a long-horizon LLM agent means evolving the harness around a frozen model or training its weights. We let a self-evolving harness make the system stronger first, then cross seed and evolved harnesses with base and trained weights to learn which gains the trained model keeps and which still need the runtime. We show that the right lever can be read off the agent's failure composition: labelling failed trajectories by the first signal that fires separates process failures (blocked calls, loops, exhausted step budgets) from content failures (a delivered plan that is poor). Harness evolution repairs the former, the behaviour it instils can be trained into the weights, and content failures are what weight training is for. On DeepPlanning, a self-evolving harness loop lifts the held-out score of Qwen3.5-4B from 0.16 to 0.30 and of Qwen3.5-9B from 0.32 to 0.44; for 4B, held-out delivery rises from 55% to 90% while content failures are left for the weights. LoRA adapters trained on evolved-harness trajectories internalise the gain: under the original harness they add +0.13 on held-out tasks for both sizes; on 4B they stack with the harness to more than double the held-out score, and on 9B the adapter alone matches the full evolution line, cutting content failures from a quarter of trajectories to one in twenty. A placebo adapter trained on answer-shuffled trajectories falls below the base model. The loop transfers to WebArena-Lite (+0.09 on 117 unseen tasks), where the gain lives in what the model sees and adapters do not add to it. The result is a diagnose-then-intervene rule applied twice: read the failure composition to choose between harness and weights, then read what the accepted edits changed to decide which gains to train in. Scores are four-rollout means against fresh anchors, same-night except where marked, across eight models from six families and two benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 进化助力训练遭遇瓶颈：何时应开始进行力量训练
articles.abstractCn: 改进长时程大型语言模型（LLM）代理意味着围绕冻结模型进化框架或训练其权重。我们让自进化框架首先增强系统，然后交叉种子和进化框架与基础及训练权重，以学习训练模型保留哪些增益以及哪些仍需运行时支持。我们证明，正确的杠杆可以从代理的失败组合中读取：通过首次触发信号标记失败的轨迹，可以将过程失败（阻塞调用、循环、耗尽步骤预算）与内容失败（交付的劣质计划）区分开。框架进化修复前者，其植入的行为可训练到权重中，而内容失败正是权重训练的目的。在DeepPlanning上，自进化框架循环将Qwen3.5-4B的保留分数从0.16提升至0.30，Qwen3.5-9B从0.32提升至0.44；对于4B模型，保留交付率从55%升至90%，而内容失败留给权重处理。在进化框架轨迹上训练的LoRA适配器内化了这一增益：在原始框架下，两种规模的适配器均对保留任务提升+0.13；在4B模型上，适配器与框架结合使保留分数翻倍以上，而在9B模型上，适配器单独即可匹配完整进化线，将内容失败从轨迹的四分之一降至二十分之一。在答案打乱轨迹上训练的安慰剂适配器低于基础模型。该循环迁移至WebArena-Lite（在117个未见任务上提升+0.09），其中增益存在于模型所见内容，适配器无法进一步增加。结果是两次应用诊断后干预规则：通过读取失败组合在框架与权重间选择，然后读取接受编辑的变化以决定训练哪些增益。分数为八种模型（来自六个系列、两个基准）针对新鲜锚点的四轮平均，除特别标注外均为同夜测试。

articles.title: Phonologically Informed Tokenization for German Speech Recognition: A Cross-Domain Study
articles.abstract: German is a morphologically rich language whose syllable structure is exceptionally well-predicted by the Knuth--Liang hyphenation algorithm. We ask whether phonologically informed tokenization can serve as a competitive target for end-to-end speech recognition. We compare three tokenizer families on the Omnilingual ASR wav2vec 2.0 backbone fine-tuned with CTC: the pretrained multilingual character inventory, a data-driven Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) over orthography, and phonologically informed units from Pyphen syllabification and grapheme-to-phoneme conversion. Across 40 fine-tunes, we evaluate on three German test sets spanning orthogonal shifts: in-domain read speech, dialectal spontaneous speech, and standard-German spontaneous speech. In-domain, all phonologically informed tokenizers match BPE and the multilingual character baseline on both WER and CER. Under domain shift the picture splits along vocabulary size rather than the linguistic axis of variation: at small vocabularies, syllable-aware tokenization improves on dialectal speech, where phonetic surface forms vary but syllable structure is preserved, and stays ahead on spontaneous speech, where new word-forms violate vocabulary closure. A phoneme-level confusion analysis further shows that all tokenizers commit the same canonical function-word errors, indicating that the acoustic encoder, not the tokenizer, dominates the error topology. Our findings suggest that tokenizer choice may depend on the vocabulary budget as much as on the distribution shift expected at deployment rather than reducing to a single universal optimum.
articles.titleCn: 基于语音学信息的德语语音识别分词：跨领域研究
articles.abstractCn: 德语是一种形态丰富的语言，其音节结构可以被Knuth-Liang连字符算法异常准确地预测。我们探究了基于语音信息的分词是否可以作为端到端语音识别的竞争性目标。我们在使用CTC微调的Omnilingual ASR wav2vec 2.0主干网络上比较了三种分词方法：预训练的多语言字符集、基于正字法的自数据驱动的Byte-Pair Encoding（BPE），以及来自Pyphen音节划分和字素到音素转换的语音信息单元。在40次微调中，我们在三个涵盖正交变化的德语测试集上进行了评估：领域内朗读语音、方言自发语音和标准德语自发语音。在领域内，所有基于语音信息的分词器在WER和CER上都与BPE和多语言字符基线匹配。在领域迁移时，情况沿着词汇量而非语言变异轴分裂：在小型词汇中，音节感知分词在方言语音上表现更好，其中语音表层形式变化但音节结构得以保留，并在自发语音上保持领先，因为新词形式违反了词汇封闭性。音素级别的混淆分析进一步表明，所有分词器都犯了相同的典型功能词错误，表明错误拓扑主要由声学编码器而非分词器主导。我们的研究表明，分词器的选择可能取决于词汇预算，与部署时预期的分布迁移同样重要，而非简化为单一通用最优解。

articles.title: UXBench Pro: Benchmarking Personalized User Experience in Multi-Turn Dialogue Interactions
articles.abstract: Evaluating user experience (UX) with automated computational methods has gained increasing attention, supported by empirical evidence from UXBench. However, binary preference prediction provides limited insight, while relying on a single user-agnostic reward model overlooks the inherent heterogeneity of users, whose expectations can differ substantially. In this paper, we present UXBench Pro, comprising 1{,}000 test instances derived from real user interactions across 12 task scenarios and 82 domains. Each instance is paired with a FACTORS user profile that characterizes the user through seven interpretable behavioral facets, differentiating user groups. To provide richer evaluation insights, we introduce a dual-perspective paradigm that combines a personalized User Reward Model (URM) for third-person judgment with Sim4Eval, a user simulator that enables multi-turn interactions and provides first-person evaluation across four cognitive state dimensions. To assess the reliability of these based evaluators, we further introduce two meta-benchmarks, URMBench and USimBench, that evaluate how faithfully they reproduce real human preferences and behaviors. Extensive experiments reveal seven key findings that highlight the importance of user modeling and multi-perspective evaluation, offering a fresh perspective on user-centric benchmarking and motivating personalized model optimization.
articles.titleCn: UXBench Pro：多轮对话交互中个性化用户体验的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 基于自动化计算方法评估用户体验（UX）已日益受到关注，UXBench的实证证据为其提供了支持。然而，二元偏好预测提供有限洞见，而依赖单一用户无关的奖励模型则忽视了用户固有的异质性，其期望可能存在显著差异。在本文中，我们提出了UXBench Pro，它包含1,000个测试实例，这些实例源自12种任务场景和82个领域的真实用户交互。每个实例都配有一个FACTORS用户画像，该画像通过七个可解释的行为维度来刻画用户，从而区分用户群体。为提供更丰富的评估洞见，我们引入了一种双视角范式，该范式结合了用于第三方判断的个性化用户奖励模型（URM）和Sim4Eval（用户模拟器），后者支持多轮交互并在四个认知状态维度提供第一人称评估。为评估这些基于评估者的可靠性，我们进一步引入了两个元基准——URMBench和USimBench，它们评估这些评估者重现真实人类偏好和行为的忠实度。大量实验揭示了七个关键发现，这些发现突出了用户建模和多视角评估的重要性，为以用户为中心的基准测试提供了新视角，并推动了个性化模型优化。

articles.title: Large Language Model Turnover Undermines Screening for Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Scientific Writing
articles.abstract: Journals and conferences have begun to screen submitted manuscripts for text written using large language models (LLMs). The reliability of this screening rests on benchmark evaluations against a fixed set of LLM versions, while the versions in actual use keep changing. Here we quantify how this LLM turnover affects the screening of scientific manuscripts. We paired 4,000 pre-ChatGPT abstracts from the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences with their rewrites by 23 LLM versions from three vendors, released between June 2023 and August 2026. We then trained detectors under maintenance scenarios ranging from a detector retrained on every new version to one trained once and never updated. Detectors trained only on a vendor's past versions can collapse at the boundaries between model generations: calibrated to falsely flag 1% of human-written abstracts, they catch above 99% of rewrites just before the sharpest boundary and 3.8% just after it. Detectors trained on later versions can also miss rewrites of earlier ones. Vocabulary differences between versions largely track where detection transfers and where it fails. In the two screening scenarios we simulated, screens covering all 23 versions either flagged one in eight human-written abstracts or missed one in three rewrites of the newest version. Indeed, a commercial detector missed most rewrites of the version just after the sharpest boundary while flagging almost no human-written abstracts. Research-integrity policy should therefore treat the benchmark accuracy of a detector as provisional, to be re-verified with every LLM release, including earlier versions.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型的更迭削弱了人工智能辅助科学写作的筛选
articles.abstractCn: 期刊和会议已开始筛选使用大型语言模型（LLM）撰写的投稿稿件。这种筛选的可靠性依赖于与固定LLM版本集的基准评估，而实际使用的版本却在不断变化。在此，我们量化了这种LLM更迭对科学论文筛选的影响。我们将4000篇预ChatGPT的《美国国家科学院院报》摘要与3家供应商在2023年6月至2026年8月间发布的23个LLM版本的改写版本进行配对。随后，我们在不同维护场景下训练了检测器，从每个新版本都重新训练的检测器到仅训练一次且永不更新的检测器。仅基于供应商过去版本训练的检测器会在模型代际边界处失效：校准为错误标记1%人类撰写的摘要后，它们在最陡峭边界前的改写版本中捕捉到超过99%，而在边界后的改写版本中仅捕捉到3.8%。基于后期版本训练的检测器也可能遗漏早期版本的改写。版本间的词汇差异很大程度上反映了检测转移和失败的位置。在我们模拟的两种筛选场景中，覆盖所有23个版本的筛选要么错误标记了八分之一的人类撰写摘要，要么遗漏了最新版本三分之一改写。事实上，商业化检测器遗漏了最陡峭边界后大多数改写版本，而几乎未标记任何人类撰写摘要。因此，科研诚信政策应将检测器的基准准确率视为临时指标，需在每个LLM发布时（包括早期版本）重新验证。

articles.title: Probing for Long-Horizon Deductive Reasoning Capabilities in Language Models with Prolog
articles.abstract: Current frontier LLMs can theoretically process long contexts with 1M tokens or more. But to what extent can they go beyond simple retrieval and perform deeper reasoning over such long contexts? We empirically investigate long-horizon reasoning capabilities of LLMs, focusing on deductive logic expressed in Prolog. We construct ProloNg, a synthetic testbed to probe Prolog Long Reasoning, which systematically varies the complexity (reasoning depth) of problems, where the hardest case has a reasoning depth of 22 and 62k context length. We study 8 reasoning models across 5 families of frontier LLMs, and find that performance degrades substantially as reasoning depth grows, with the majority of models approaching chance beyond depth 10.
articles.titleCn: 使用Prolog对语言模型进行长时域能力探查
articles.abstractCn: 当前最前沿的大型语言模型理论上能够处理包含100万或更多token的长文本。但它们能在多大程度上超越简单的检索，并在这些长文本中进行更深层次的推理？我们通过实证研究探索了大型语言模型的长时程推理能力，重点关注Prolog中表达的演绎逻辑。我们构建了ProloNg，一个用于探测Prolog长推理能力的合成测试平台，该平台系统地变化问题的复杂度（推理深度），其中最难的案例推理深度为22，上下文长度为62k。我们研究了5个前沿大型语言模型家族中的8个推理模型，发现随着推理深度的增加，性能显著下降，大多数模型在深度超过10后接近随机水平。

articles.title: Measuring Cultural Alignment Beyond the Average: A Framework for Evaluating Maternal-Health LLM Interactions in Indian Contexts
articles.abstract: Existing evaluation methods for healthcare LLMs primarily assess factual correctness,safety, and fluency, while providing limited insight into whether generated interactions reflect culturally situated healthcare reasoning. This limitation is particularly important in maternal health, where care decisions are shaped by social and relational norms. We introduce MH-INDIC, a culturally grounded evaluation framework for maternal-health interactions in urban and semi-urban North Indian contexts that operationalises cultural behaviour through ten dimensions of maternal-health reasoning. Using a 26-item survey administered to 102 pregnant and postpartum women from urban and semi-urban North India, we evaluate ten LLMs. We distinguish population level cultural alignment from profile-level behavioural variation. Although several models approximate the human population-level distribution, all evaluated systems exhibit substantially lower variation across demographic and household profiles than the human cohort, revealing a gap between aggregate alignment and profile-conditioned sensitivity. As a downstream application of MH-INDIC, we use the strongest-aligned proprietary and open-source models to generate culturally conditioned maternal-health dialogues under zero-shot, self-conditioned, and human-grounded prompting. Human-grounded conditioning produces stronger profile alignment and dialogue quality ratings, suggesting that measured cultural profiles can improve the cultural grounding of generated interactions
articles.titleCn: 超越平均值的跨文化契合度测量：评估印度情境下母性健康大型语言模型交互的框架
articles.abstractCn: 现有的医疗领域大型语言模型（LLM）评估方法主要侧重于事实准确性、安全性和流畅性，但在评估生成的交互是否反映文化背景下的医疗推理方面提供有限见解。这一局限性在母体健康领域尤为重要，因为护理决策受到社会和关系规范的影响。我们引入了MH-INDIC，这是一个基于文化的评估框架，用于评估北印度城市和半城市化地区的母体健康交互，通过十项母体健康推理维度来操作化文化行为。通过向102名来自北印度城市和半城市化地区的孕产妇发放包含26个项目的调查问卷，我们评估了十种LLM。我们将群体层面的文化一致性从个人层面的行为差异区分开来。尽管几个模型近似于人类群体层面的分布，但所有评估的系统在人口统计和家庭背景方面表现出远低于人类群体的显著变异，揭示了总体一致性与个人条件敏感度之间的差距。作为MH-INDIC的下游应用，我们使用最具文化一致性的专有和开源模型，在零样本、自我条件和人类条件提示下生成文化条件化的母体健康对话。人类条件提示产生了更强的个人一致性对话质量评分，表明测量的文化特征可以改善生成交互的文化基础。

articles.title: Adapting English Quality Classifiers for Multilingual LLM Pretraining Data Selection
articles.abstract: Recent advances in large language model (LLM) pretraining highlight the role of high-quality training data in improving performance. While model-based filtering has proven effective in selecting high-quality subsets from web-scale corpora, especially for high-resource languages, low-resource languages face challenges due to limited availability of annotated data. This work explores extending quality filtering to over 100 languages by proposing a multilingual adaptation approach that converts an existing English quality classifier into a multilingual variant. Our approach proposes training a small multi-layer perceptron on top of Transformer encoder-only model embeddings, using multilingual text as input and scores obtained from English classifiers applied to machine-translated text as labels. Our 1B, 3B and 8B scale experiments show that our approach maintains the downstream LLM benchmark performance of existing multilingual model-based filtering baselines, without harming regional and cultural knowledge benchmarks. To further evaluate cross-lingual generalization, we compare classifier scores of high-quality synthetic data and web samples, and the correlation of classifier scores with LLM-based ones, revealing that the classifier can learn the scoring criteria of its original English variant, even for languages not included in its training data.
articles.titleCn: 为多语言大语言模型预训练数据选择适配英语质量分类器
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）预训练的最新进展突出了高质量训练数据在提升性能方面的重要性。虽然基于模型的过滤已被证明在从网络规模语料库中选择高质量子集方面非常有效，特别是对于资源丰富的语言，但低资源语言由于标注数据的有限可用性而面临挑战。本研究探索通过提出一种多语言适应方法来扩展质量过滤，将现有的英语质量分类器转换为多语言变体。我们的方法提出在Transformer编码器模型嵌入的基础上训练一个小型多层感知器，使用多语言文本作为输入，并使用英语分类器应用于机器翻译文本获得的分数作为标签。我们的1B、3B和8B规模实验表明，我们的方法保持了现有基于模型的多语言过滤基线的下游LLM基准性能，同时没有损害区域和文化知识基准。为了进一步评估跨语言泛化能力，我们比较了高质量合成数据和网页样本的分类器分数，以及分类器分数与基于LLM的分数的相关性，揭示分类器可以学习其原始英语变体的评分标准，即使对于未包含在其训练数据中的语言也是如此。

articles.title: Chronos Enables Code Agents to Reason over Software Evolution
articles.abstract: Historical pull requests record the design decisions, compatibility constraints, and implementation patterns behind a codebase's current state. Experience relevant to a new task can span related changes whose descriptions emphasize different concerns. We introduce Chronos, a test-time framework that makes this connected history available to large language model (LLM)-based code agents. Chronos distills merged pull requests into structured experience cards and connects them through a typed graph of code-level, developer-intent, and organizational relations. Semantic search identifies entry cards, and weighted multi-hop expansion retrieves connected changes for selective reading. The same memory guides candidate generation and patch selection: a patch-focused change agent and a validation-strategy agent each develop a patch, and an evolution steward consults history to select between them. On SWE-Bench Verified, the full workflow improves SWE-Agent across all six evaluated LLM backbones, raising the mean resolution rate from 69.2% to 72.9% and reaching 79.8% with MiniMax M2.5. With the same backbone, it raises resolution rates from 48.3% to 51.7% on SWE-Bench Pro and from 41.0% to 43.5% on FEA-Bench Lite. Both experience-guided single-agent variants also outperform the base agent. In a human evaluation on 100 tasks with ten cards retrieved per task, graph-grounded retrieval increases the mean number of useful cards from 1.24 to 2.87 over flat semantic retrieval. These results demonstrate the value of PR relations for retrieving useful repository experience and of the evaluated workflows for applying that experience during patch generation and selection.
articles.titleCn: Chronos使代码代理能够推理软件演化
articles.abstractCn: 历史拉取请求记录了代码库当前状态背后的设计决策、兼容性约束和实现模式。与新任务相关的经验可以涵盖描述不同关注点的相关变更。我们介绍了Chronos，一个在测试时向基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代码代理提供这种关联历史的框架。Chronos将合并的拉取请求提炼为结构化的经验卡片，并通过代码级、开发者意图和组织关系的类型化图连接它们。语义搜索用于识别入口卡片，而加权的多跳扩展则用于检索相关变更以供选择性阅读。相同的记忆指导候选生成和补丁选择：一个以补丁为中心的变更代理和一个验证策略代理各自开发补丁，而一个进化管理者则参考历史来选择它们。在SWE-Bench Verified上，完整的工作流程在所有六个评估的LLM主干上提升了SWE-Agent的表现，将平均解决率从69.2%提高到72.9%，并在MiniMax M2.5上达到79.8%。使用相同的主干，它在SWE-Bench Pro上将解决率从48.3%提高到51.7%，在FEA-Bench Lite上从41.0%提高到43.5%。这两种经验引导的单代理变体也优于基础代理。在一个涉及100个任务、每个任务检索十张卡片的评估中，基于图的检索比扁平语义检索将有用卡片的平均数量从1.24提高到2.87。这些结果表明了PR关系在检索有用仓库经验方面的价值，以及评估的工作流程在补丁生成和选择过程中应用这些经验的价值。

articles.title: Smoothing the Top-k Exposure Boundary for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
articles.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts models scale parameter capacity efficiently while maintaining a fixed compute budget per token. However, traditional training paradigms enforce a static choice of top-$k$ experts, which converts a continuous routing distribution into a rigid step function. This constraint introduces a brittle boundary where highly competitive experts are arbitrarily separated into full-supervision and zero-feedback zones based on minor score fluctuations. To address this issue, we propose Elastic Expert Routing, which stochastically samples the active expert budget from a localized discrete distribution centered at $k$. Over multiple training iterations, this mechanism softens the sharp threshold into a gradual probability distribution. Because the sampling neighborhood remains symmetric, this approach matches the expected computational cost of deterministic training, while preserving the inference budget. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of our method on both supervised fine-tuning and from-scratch pretraining settings. During supervised fine-tuning, elastic routing improves downstream macro-averages on OLMoE-1B-7B and Qwen3-30B-A3B by $+0.84$ and $+2.02$ points, respectively. In addition, in from-scratch pretraining, it outperforms the static top-$k$ baseline by $1.6$ points on average across downstream tasks.
articles.titleCn: 平滑稀疏专家混合模型的Top-k曝光边界
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏专家混合模型能够高效地扩展比例参数容量，同时保持每个token的固定计算预算。然而，传统的训练范式强制选择静态的top-k专家，将连续的路由分布转换为刚性的阶跃函数。这种约束引入了一个脆弱的边界，根据微小的分数波动，将竞争激烈的专家任意地划分为全监督和零反馈区域。为解决此问题，我们提出了弹性专家路由，该机制从以k为中心的局部离散分布中随机采样激活专家预算。在多次训练迭代中，该机制将尖锐的阈值软化成逐渐的概率分布。由于采样邻域保持对称，这种方法匹配了确定性训练的预期计算成本，同时保留了推理预算。大量实验表明，我们的方法在监督微调和从头开始预训练设置中均有效。在监督微调期间，弹性路由将OLMoE-1B-7B和Qwen3-30B-A3B的下游宏观平均值分别提高了+0.84和+2.02分。此外，在从头开始预训练中，它在下游任务上的平均表现优于静态top-k基线1.6分。

articles.title: Incremental Open-Ended Deep Research with Structured Harness
articles.abstract: Existing Open-Ended Deep Research (OEDR) systems primarily generate reports from scratch, making them inefficient for scenarios where research reports need to be continuously maintained as new information emerges. We introduce \textbf{Incremental Open-Ended Deep Research (Incremental-OEDR)}, a research setting that treats a report as an evolving research state and incrementally updates it by preserving valid knowledge, revising outdated or incomplete content, and incorporating newly available information. To support this setting, we propose \textbf{Structured Harness}, which represents reports as structured collections of outlines, sections, and supporting evidence, and provides structured retrieval, a persistent structured evidence pool, and structured generation for selective report updating and evidence reuse. We further establish a temporal evaluation framework spanning ten years, with \emph{Single-Step Task} and \emph{Long-Chain Task} to evaluate incremental updates over both individual transitions and long-term update chains. Extensive Experiments on DeepResearch Bench and DeepConsult under both the Open-source Configuration (OC) and Proprietary Configuration (PC) show that Incremental-OEDR maintains competitive report quality while substantially improving report continuity and reducing research costs. As shown in Figure~\ref{fig:profile}, it achieves up to 0.51 higher content-level ROUGE-L F1, 0.63 higher outline-level EM F1, 33\% lower token consumption, and 61\% fewer search calls than OEDR on DeepResearch Bench. For more details, please refer to our project page: https://ioedr-project.github.io/.
articles.titleCn: 增量式开放式深度研究结构化接口
articles.abstractCn: 现有的开放式深度研究（OEDR）系统主要从零开始生成报告，这使得它们在需要持续维护研究报告以应对新信息涌现的场景中效率低下。我们引入了**增量开放式深度研究（Incremental-OEDR）**，这是一种将报告视为不断发展的研究状态的研究设置，通过保留有效知识、修订过时或不完整的内容以及整合新信息来逐步更新报告。为了支持这一设置，我们提出了**结构化支架（Structured Harness）**，该支架将报告表示为包含提纲、章节和支撑证据的结构化集合，并提供结构化检索、持久化的结构化证据库以及结构化生成，以实现选择性报告更新和证据重用。我们进一步建立了一个跨越十年的时间评估框架，包含**单步任务（Single-Step Task）**和**长链任务（Long-Chain Task）**，用于评估在单个转换和长期更新链中的增量更新。在DeepResearch Bench和DeepConsult上的大量实验（在开源配置（OC）和专有配置（PC）下）表明，Incremental-OEDR在保持竞争性报告质量的同时，显著提高了报告的连续性并降低了研究成本。如图~\ref{fig:profile}所示，在DeepResearch Bench上，Incremental-OEDR比OEDR在内容级ROUGE-L F1上提高了0.51，在提纲级EM F1上提高了0.63，token消耗降低了33%，搜索调用次数减少了61%。更多详情请参考我们的项目页面：https://ioedr-project.github.io/。

articles.title: SWE-Journey: Towards More Realistic Evaluation of Coding Assistants through Long-Horizon, Multi-Turn Interaction
articles.abstract: Coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex have become a major application of LLM agents, yet existing benchmarks remain far from real-world use, particularly in task horizon and interaction length. Code assistants require completing long chains of development work in continuously evolving repositories, while repeatedly clarifying requirements and adapting implementations through multi-turn interaction. To address these gaps, we introduce SWE-Journey, a benchmark for more realistic evaluation of coding assistants. To address the task-horizon gap, we propose a weak-to-strong synthesis pipeline that automatically constructs long-horizon coding tasks. To address the interaction gap, we mine four representative user personas from real interaction data and build a user-simulation agent to reproduce realistic code-assistance interactions. On average, models pass over 75% of tests for requested functionality with software architects, but fewer than 25% with non-coders. These results show that current coding assistants still fall short of enabling reliable coding for non-coders. We further analyze the reasons for this gap and identify asking right, finding right, and fixing right as key capabilities during interaction.
articles.titleCn: SWE-Journey：通过长时程、多轮交互实现编码助手更真实的评估
articles.abstractCn: 代码助手如Claude Code和Codex已成为LLM代理的主要应用，但现有的基准测试与实际应用仍有很大差距，特别是在任务时间跨度和交互长度方面。代码助手需要在不断演变的代码库中完成长链的开发工作，并通过多轮交互反复澄清需求、调整实现。为解决这些差距，我们引入了SWE-Journey，这是一个用于更真实评估代码助手的基准测试。为解决任务时间跨度差距，我们提出了一种从弱到强的合成流程，自动构建长时间跨度的代码任务。为解决交互长度差距，我们从真实交互数据中挖掘出四个典型用户角色，并构建了一个用户模拟代理来重现真实的代码助手交互。平均而言，模型在与软件架构师交互时，超过75%的测试通过了所需功能，但在与非程序员交互时，通过率不到25%。这些结果表明，当前的代码助手仍然无法使非程序员实现可靠的编码。我们进一步分析了造成这种差距的原因，并确定了在交互过程中“提出正确问题”、“找到正确解决方案”和“修正正确问题”是关键能力。

articles.title: Prosody-to-Text: Predicting text from low-pass filtered speech
articles.abstract: While predicting prosody from text is an established task in the field, the opposite direction, predicting text that fits a given prosodic pattern, remains largely overlooked. We find this unfortunate, because this opposite direction could lead to some very interesting use cases. Therefore, in this paper, we make the first steps in the prosody-to-text direction by inves- tigating how much of the original sentence can be recovered from its prosodic pattern. To this end, we fine-tune the Whis- per model using only the 12 lowest Mel bins (low-pass filter with approximately 450Hz cutoff), and obtain surprisingly accurate results (WER 36%), with 10% of utterances be- ing recovered perfectly, and 40% of utterances having Word Error Rate at or below 25%. We also find that, given the correct prefix, the next token was predicted correctly in 79% of cases. Our results suggest that the relationship between low-frequency speech features and lexical content is much stronger than previously thought, and we believe that direct- ing more attention to this topic might open the door to new applications, such as using prosody to guide text generation of modern LLMs

articles.titleCn: 韵律到文本：从低通滤波语音预测文本
articles.abstractCn: 虽然从文本预测韵律是一个已确立的领域任务，但相反的方向，即预测符合给定韵律模式的文本，却基本被忽视。我们认为这很遗憾，因为相反的方向可能带来一些非常有趣的应用场景。因此，在本文中，我们通过研究从韵律模式中可以恢复多少原始句子内容，在韵律到文本的方向上迈出了第一步。为此，我们仅使用12个最低Mel频带（约450Hz截止频率的低通滤波器）对Whisper模型进行微调，并获得了令人惊讶的准确结果（错误率36%），其中10%的语句被完美恢复，40%的语句错误率在25%或以下。我们还发现，在给出正确的前缀的情况下，下一个词在79%的情况下被正确预测。我们的结果表明，低频语音特征与词汇内容之间的关系比以前认为的更强，我们相信将更多注意力集中在这一主题上可能会为新的应用打开大门，例如使用韵律来指导现代大型语言模型的文本生成。

articles.title: Learning the Loop, Not Just the Page: Execution-Grounded Loop Learning for Web Generation
articles.abstract: Functional Web generation is increasingly optimized with executable rewards, yet existing methods largely focus on the quality of the final page and leave the process of diagnosing and repairing imperfect implementations underexplored. We identify a central challenge in this setting: the Generator and Refiner produce executable artifacts with direct environment rewards, whereas the intermediate Critic influences downstream behavior without a directly executable outcome. We introduce WebLoop, an execution-grounded framework that jointly learns generation, critique, and refinement within a shared policy. WebLoop trains an execution-free Critic with complementary signals for requirement-level discriminability and downstream helpfulness, first establishing reliable diagnosis and then introducing consequence-aware credit, while all three roles are jointly optimized with group-relative policy learning. With Qwen3.5-9B, WebLoop reaches 41.5 Overall on WebRise and 38.9% accuracy on WebGen-Bench, improving the base model by 11.3 and 15.4 points, respectively. The gains transfer to first-pass generation, persist at 27B scale, and generalize from text-only training to multimodal inputs. Controlled analyses further show that the improvement cannot be explained by an additional refinement pass alone, highlighting the importance of learning the Critic and the loop itself.
articles.titleCn: 学习循环，而不仅仅是页面：面向执行的循环学习用于网页生成
articles.abstractCn: 功能型网页生成正越来越多地通过可执行奖励进行优化，但现有方法主要关注最终页面的质量，而诊断和修复不完美实现的过程则探索不足。我们在此环境中识别出一个核心挑战：生成器和细化器产生具有直接环境奖励的可执行工件，而中间的评论家则在不具有直接可执行结果的情况下影响下游行为。我们引入了WebLoop，这是一个基于执行框架，在共享策略内联合学习生成、评论和细化。WebLoop训练了一个无执行评论家，具有互补信号以实现需求级别的可区分性和下游有用性，首先建立可靠的诊断，然后引入结果感知的信用，而所有三个角色都通过相对策略学习进行联合优化。使用Qwen3.5-9B，WebLoop在WebRise上达到41.5的整体评分，在WebGen-Bench上达到38.9%的准确率，分别比基础模型提高了11.3和15.4分。这些提升转移到了一次性生成，在27B规模下持续存在，并从纯文本训练泛化到多模态输入。受控分析进一步表明，这种改进不能仅用额外的细化步骤来解释，突出了学习评论家和循环本身的重要性。

articles.title: Constitutional Gating and Deterministic Recovery for Multi-Agent LLM Negotiation: Ablations Against a Stateful Adversarial Gatekeeper
articles.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems negotiating with a stateful counterpart waste model calls in three ways: polite loops that never meet the counterpart's hidden acceptance condition, malformed outputs that trigger retries, and compliance deadlocks in which the counterpart demands something the agent must refuse. We study a three-part control stack - a 5-Pillar runtime constitution, a 4-tier swarm (Director, three-agent majority vote, Monitor, schema hard gate) and Cognitive Annealing (deterministic deadlock detection, atomic purge of the agent-side context, a canonical recovery message) - against a released adversarial Gatekeeper whose acceptance rules are fixed regular expressions and whose LLM only renders reply text. The testbed has a known solution: it measures whether the stack executes a constitution-aligned strategy against swarm drift and recovers from deadlock, not whether it discovers anything. In five runs per configuration (30 runs; Gemini 2.5 Pro agents, Claude Haiku 4.5 Gatekeeper) we find: (i) the constitution and Director make an acceptable framing possible but not reliable - 0/5 baseline unlocks versus 1/5 and 2/5 with the constitution; when the swarm unlocks it does so in one turn with 7-8 calls and about 15k tokens (67-73% below baseline); when it does not, it costs 17-38% more; (ii) the Monitor and hard gate do not reduce unlocks and leave an audit trail; (iii) under a honeytrap-to-compliance deadlock, LLM-only steering escapes 0 of 5 times while atomic purge plus a canonical strike escapes 5 of 5 (Fisher $p = 0.008$) at the same call budget, with zero calls for the strike. LLM-written strikes failed the deterministic pre-flight 5 of 5 times although an LLM Monitor had approved four. Pre-registered hypotheses on average call and token reduction were not supported. Cost is bounded in every arm by deterministic stop rules; the stack adds recovery at no extra model cost.

articles.titleCn: 多智能体LLM谈判中的宪法门控与确定性恢复：针对状态化对抗守门员的消融研究
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体LLM系统在与状态化对手谈判时，通过三种方式浪费模型调用：礼貌循环从未满足对手的隐藏接受条件、格式错误的输出触发重试，以及合规死锁，其中对手要求智能体必须拒绝的内容。我们研究了一个三部分控制栈——一个5支柱运行时宪法、一个4层群组（导演、三智能体多数投票、监控器、模式硬门）和认知退火（确定性死锁检测、智能体端上下文的原子清除、规范恢复消息）——针对一个已发布的对抗性守门人，其接受规则是固定的正则表达式，其LLM仅渲染回复文本。测试平台有一个已知解决方案：它衡量的是栈是否执行符合宪法的策略对抗群组漂移并从死锁中恢复，而不是是否发现任何东西。在每种配置下运行五次（总共30次；Gemini 2.5 Pro智能体，Claude Haiku 4.5守门人）我们发现：(i) 宪法和导演使得可接受的框架成为可能但不可靠——0/5基线解锁与宪法下的1/5和2/5；当群组解锁时，它在一轮内以7-8次调用和约15k个token完成（比基线低67-73%）；当它不解锁时，成本增加17-38%；(ii) 监控器和硬门并未减少解锁并留下审计记录；(iii) 在蜜罐到合规的死锁下，仅由LLM引导的逃脱次数为0/5，而原子清除加上规范打击的逃脱次数为5/5（Fisher p = 0.008），在相同的调用预算下，打击无需任何调用。LLM编写的打击在5/5次预飞行中失败，尽管LLM监控器已批准四次。预先注册的平均调用和token减少假设未被支持。成本在每条路径上均由确定性停止规则限制；栈在不增加额外模型成本的情况下增加了恢复能力。

articles.title: When Can You Prune Your Network? A Study of Intermediate Neurons in Multilingual Speech Parsing
articles.abstract: End-to-end speech parsing, a task recently proposed, consists in predicting both the transcription and the syntactic tree for a spoken utterance. Existing architectures for speech parsing often utilise intermediate neural networks. In this work, we examine the effectiveness of intermediate neural networks (NN) for parsing, and, specifically, what role do they play. We introduce a simpler end-to-end architecture for speech parsing, where we remove these intermediate NN units, reducing the parameters by 12%, while achieving comparable or better performance than prior method on both automatic speech recognition (ASR) and parsing. We demonstrate that intermediate NN units help reduce the representational gap when the pre-trained encoder is frozen. We do a comprehensive evaluation of speech parsing on French, and medium-low resource languages Slovenian and Naija. We further investigate the impact of the training data size and intermediate layers of the pretrained speech encoder on speech parsing.

articles.titleCn: 何时修剪你的网络？一项关于多语言语音解析中的中间神经元的研究
articles.abstractCn: 端到端语音解析，是一项近期提出的新任务，其目标是对语音指令同时进行转录和句法树预测。现有的语音解析架构通常利用中间神经网络。在本研究中，我们考察了中间神经网络在解析任务中的有效性，并具体探究了它们所起的作用。我们引入了一种更简单的端到端语音解析架构，去除了这些中间神经网络单元，参数量减少了12%，同时在自动语音识别（ASR）和解析任务上取得了与先前方法相当甚至更好的性能。我们证明，中间神经网络单元有助于在预训练编码器冻结时减少表征差距。我们对法语以及资源中低语的斯洛文尼亚语和奈及利亚语进行了全面的语音解析评估。我们进一步研究了训练数据规模和预训练语音编码器的中间层对语音解析的影响。

articles.title: Residual Advantage: Student-Relative Teacher Guidance for RL with Verifiable Rewards
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and on-policy distillation (OPD) have become two main paradigms for post-training reasoning models. RLVR gives each response a single outcome label, leaving the steps inside it without separate credit. OPD provides token-level guidance at student-visited prefixes, but its pointwise signal does not directly reflect the pattern of teacher--student disagreement across the vocabulary. Dense, unbounded log-ratio supervision can amplify the teacher's influence, yet a strong solver is not necessarily a suitable guide when the student's solution paths depart from the teacher's. We propose Residual Advantage (\RA{}), which treats the teacher--student probability residual as a bounded one-step reward, subtracts the corresponding state value under the student policy to form a standard advantage, and centers the result within each response before adding it to the verifier advantage. The guidance term has zero mean within each response, so the verifier advantage remains the response's mean label and the teacher only redistributes credit among the steps within it. \CoRA{} further updates a teacher LoRA with verifier advantages on the same scored student batch and uses the updated teacher in the next iteration's residual, adapting guidance to the student's attempts. With Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-4B-Base students and a Qwen3-8B teacher, \RA{} combined with GRPO or REINFORCE++ improves the underlying sequence-advantage algorithm in all 24 comparisons on three mathematical benchmarks, raising macro Avg@8 by 1.7--3.6 points and Pass@8 by 3.9--6.3 points. Both combinations surpass teacher-only OPD, and \CoRA{} adds a further 1.0--1.5 Avg@8 points.
articles.titleCn: 残差优势：基于可验证奖励的强化学习中的学生相对教师指导
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）和策略内蒸馏（OPD）已成为训练后推理模型的两种主要范式。RLVR为每个响应分配单一结果标签，而忽略其内部步骤的单独信用。OPD在学生访问的前缀提供标记级指导，但其逐点信号并未直接反映教师与学生之间词汇上的分歧模式。密集、无界的对数比监督可以增强教师的影响，但当学生的解决方案路径偏离教师时，强大的求解器未必是合适的引导。我们提出了残差优势（\RA{}），将教师与学生概率残差视为有界的一步奖励，减去学生策略下的相应状态值以形成标准优势，并在每个响应内对结果进行居中处理，然后将其添加到验证器优势中。指导项在每个响应内具有零均值，因此验证器优势保持为响应的均值标签，而教师仅在其内部步骤之间重新分配信用。\CoRA{}进一步使用验证器优势更新同一评分学生批次上的教师LoRA，并在下一轮残差中使用更新后的教师，使指导适应学生的尝试。使用Qwen3-1.7B-Base和Qwen3-4B-Base学生以及Qwen3-8B教师，\RA{}结合GRPO或REINFORCE++在三个数学基准的24项比较中均改进了底层序列优势算法，将宏观Avg@8提升1.7--3.6分，Pass@8提升3.9--6.3分。这两种组合均超越了仅使用教师的OPD，而\CoRA{}额外提升了1.0--1.5分的Avg@8。

articles.title: Does Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) Dominate Arabic Dialects in LLMs? A Representation-Level Analysis
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often default to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) when generating Arabic, even when prompted with dialectal Arabic. A natural explanation is that their internal representations are dominated by MSA. We test this hypothesis by adapting the language-dominance framework of Shani and Basirat (2025) (https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2025.blackboxnlp-1.7) to 26 Arabic varieties. Across layers and model families, we find no evidence that MSA acts as a dominant internal representation for Arabic dialects. Instead, dialect representations form a dense and highly overlapping space: normalized mutual information drops sharply compared to patterns reported for more distinct languages. Moreover, the strongest separability effects are not confined to intermediate layers, but can shift toward later layers depending on the architecture. These findings challenge a common interpretation of MSA-biased generation: output preference does not necessarily reveal internal representational dominance. Analyses of multilingual and dialectal LLMs should therefore distinguish generation bias from the geometry of internal representations.
articles.titleCn: 现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）在大型语言模型中是否主导阿拉伯方言？一项表示层面的分析
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成阿拉伯语时，即使提示使用方言阿拉伯语，也常常默认使用现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）。一个自然的解释是，它们的内部表示主要由MSA主导。我们通过将Shani和Basirat（2025）的语言主导框架（https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2025.blackboxnlp-1.7）扩展到26种阿拉伯语变体来验证这一假设。在各个层级和模型家族中，我们没有发现MSA作为阿拉伯语方言主导内部表示的证据。相反，方言表示形成一个密集且高度重叠的空间：与更不同语言报告的模式相比，归一化互信息急剧下降。此外，最强的可分离性效应并非局限于中间层级，而是会根据架构变化而向后期层级转移。这些发现挑战了MSA偏向生成的常见解释：输出偏好并不一定揭示内部表示的主导性。因此，对多语言和方言LLMs的分析应区分生成偏向与内部表示的几何结构。

articles.title: Beyond Sequences: Distilling Structured Decision Memory for LLM Recommendation
articles.abstract: Despite the adoption of large language models (LLMs) in recommendation systems, prevailing approaches mostly model single-type behaviors (e.g., views or purchases). Even when incorporating multiple behaviors, existing methods flatten heterogeneous actions into homogeneous token sequences, ignoring their distinct decision-making roles. This flattening fails to capture semantic hierarchies and contextual nuances in complex decision-making, such as trade-offs between price and quality. Consequently, performance degrades in critical ``difficult-choice'' scenarios involving highly similar items. To bridge this gap, we propose MARI (Memory-Augmented Recommendation with Interpretability), which grounds predictions in explicit, structured decision evidence. MARI maintains a Decision Memory Bank (DMB) that archives users' past rationales as Structured Decision Memories (SDMs): concise records of goals, constraints, and trade-offs. These SDMs are generated offline via Post-Hoc Decision Distillation from heterogeneous behaviors and user-generated content. By retrieving relevant SDMs to augment LLM reasoning, MARI achieves interpretability and scalability without the prohibitive cost of processing long raw sequences. Extensive experiments show MARI significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on standard next-item prediction and a newly introduced Difficult Choice Prediction task, incurring low latency overhead by decoupling memory construction from online inference. Qualitative analyses reveal actionable, human-readable insights into user decision-making, marking a concrete step toward reasoning-aware recommendation systems.
articles.titleCn: 超越序列：为大型语言模型推荐系统提炼结构化决策记忆
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）已被应用于推荐系统，但现有方法大多仅对单类型行为（如浏览或购买）进行建模。即使整合了多种行为，现有方法仍将异构动作扁平化为同构的token序列，忽略了它们各自不同的决策角色。这种扁平化处理无法捕捉复杂决策过程中的语义层次和上下文细节，例如价格与质量之间的权衡。因此，在涉及高度相似物品的关键“困难选择”场景中，性能会显著下降。为弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了MARI（可解释的内存增强推荐），该模型将预测基于明确的、结构化的决策证据。MARI维护一个决策记忆库（DMB），用于存储用户的过往推理记录为结构化决策记忆（SDM）：这些SDM是关于目标、约束和权衡的简洁记录。这些SDM通过从异构行为和用户生成内容中离线生成后验决策蒸馏来创建。通过检索相关的SDM来增强LLM的推理，MARI在不产生高昂的原始长序列处理成本的情况下，实现了可解释性和可扩展性。大量实验表明，在标准的下一项预测任务和一个新引入的困难选择预测任务上，MARI显著优于现有最佳基线，并通过将记忆构建与在线推理解耦，实现了低延迟开销。定性分析揭示了用户决策的可操作、人类可读的洞察，标志着迈向推理感知推荐系统的具体一步。

articles.title: SAGE: Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis for Visual Grounding in Vision-Language Decoders
articles.abstract: Recent large vision-language models (VLMs) pair a visual encoder with a large language model (LLM) and perform well on diverse image-text tasks, yet their reliability is often limited by decoder attention pathologies that suppress visual evidence and exacerbate hallucinations. In this paper, we revisit visual attention sinks and uncover a structured, layer-dependent behavior: across prompts, early and late decoder layers exhibit prompt-invariant attention collapse onto the same few image regions, which we term PIS (Prompt-Invariant Sinks), whereas mid layers become prompt-conditioned and drive vision-language alignment. This split suggests that treating sinks as a uniform effect is incomplete. Building on this insight, we propose SAGE (Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis), a lightweight intervention that steers decoder attention away from PIS and toward query-dependent regions of interest (ROIs) using token-aligned ROI masks derived from standard vision backbones such as CLIP, ViT, and DINOv3. Evaluated on diverse vision-encoder + decoder-only LLM VLM families, SAGE improves visual grounding, reduces hallucinations, and yields consistent gains across public downstream vision-language benchmarks, including fine-grained visual discrimination settings where localized evidence is crucial, when instantiated with backbone-derived ROI masks.
articles.titleCn: SAGE：感知消融引导的视觉语言解码器中的视觉定位
articles.abstractCn: 近期的大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）将视觉编码器与大语言模型（LLM）相结合，在多种图像-文本任务上表现优异，但它们的可靠性往往受限于解码器注意力路径的缺陷，这些缺陷会抑制视觉证据并加剧幻觉。在本文中，我们重新审视视觉注意力陷阱，并揭示了一种结构化、层依赖的行为：跨不同提示，早期和晚期解码器层表现出对相同少数图像区域的提示不变注意力崩溃，我们称之为PIS（提示不变陷阱），而中间层则变为提示条件化，并驱动视觉-语言对齐。这种分裂表明，将陷阱视为单一效应是不完整的。基于这一见解，我们提出了SAGE（陷阱感知引导强调），这是一种轻量级干预措施，它利用从标准视觉骨干（如CLIP、ViT和DINOv3）派生的、标记对齐的区域感兴趣（ROI）掩码，引导解码器注意力远离PIS，转向与查询相关的ROI。在多种视觉编码器+仅解码器LLM VLM家族上评估，SAGE通过使用骨干派生的ROI掩码实例化，提高了视觉基础，减少了幻觉，并在包括需要局部证据的细粒度视觉辨别设置在内的公共下游视觉-语言基准测试中实现了持续的提升。

articles.title: Who Verifies the Verifier? Co-Evolving Inspectable Graders with Self-Improving Agents
articles.abstract: We changed the agent: did it actually get better? Every self-improving agent loop answers this hundreds of times, and every answer comes from a verifier. On open-ended tasks none exists, so the loop is handed a hand-written rubric or a bare LLM judge grading output from a model like itself, inviting reward hacking and shared blind spots. We make the verifier the evolving object: an inspectable expression over small, mostly deterministic drawback detectors, synthesized from clustered failures, gated at birth, and selected for agreement with a ten-item anchored reference set plus consensus over unlabeled outputs, never for the agent's score. On MBPP+ it gains +0.21 held-out agreement over the hand-authored seed composition, on every seed, and ends ahead of the bare LLM judge it contains. One finding should change how co-evolved verifiers are validated: removing the anchor guards collapses the verifier into a vacuous always-pass grader, yet that collapsed verifier trains skills just as well. Downstream task score cannot certify a self-evolved verifier. Score does answer sufficiency, and there an evolved verifier can substitute: Double Ratchet, pairing the verifier with a lifecycle-managed skill loop, retains 88-110% of the lift that ground truth or a rubric buys the same loop, across code generation, enterprise text-to-SQL, and reference-free report generation. When evolved skills gamed the report rubric, an outer judge caught it and one added detector repaired it; the judge itself was wrong until given the task contract.

articles.titleCn: 谁验证验证者？协同进化可检评分者与自我改进代理
articles.abstractCn: 我们更换了评估代理：实际效果真的有所改善吗？每个自我改进的代理循环都会数百次回答这个问题，而每次回答都来自一个验证者。在开放式任务中不存在这样的验证者，因此循环只能接受手写的评分标准或一个裸LLM裁判对自身模型输出进行评分，这会诱使奖励攻击和共享的盲点。我们将验证者设为不断进化的对象：一个可检查的表达式，它由小规模、大部分确定性缺陷检测器组成，这些检测器是从聚类失败中综合而来的，在出生时受到限制，并选择与一个包含十个基准项目的参考集以及未标记输出的共识相一致的验证者，而不是基于代理的得分。在MBPP+上，它在每个种子上获得了比手写种子组合高出+0.21的保留一致性，并且始终领先于它所包含的裸LLM裁判。一个发现应该改变协同进化的验证者的验证方式：移除基准保护会使验证者变成一个空洞的总是通过评分者，但这个坍缩的验证器同样能训练出技能。下游任务得分不能证明自我进化的验证者。得分确实回答了充分性，并且在这个方面，进化的验证者可以替代：双棘轮机制，将验证者与生命周期管理的技能循环配对，在代码生成、企业文本到SQL和企业无参考报告生成任务中，保留了与基准真实值或评分标准为同一循环带来的88-110%的提升。当进化的技能操纵了报告评分标准时，一个外部裁判发现了这个问题，并且一个额外的检测器修复了它；裁判本身直到收到任务合同之前都是错误的。

articles.title: Beyond Speech Captions: Speech-Rewarded Style Planning for Conversational Text-to-Speech
articles.abstract: Natural-language style descriptions provide an interpretable interface between large language models (LLMs) and controllable text-to-speech (TTS). However, using descriptions as pseudo-labels compresses target acoustics into text, and descriptive fidelity need not imply effective control of a particular synthesizer. We empirically show that speech-text alignment only weakly predicts downstream acoustic similarity among candidate instructions for the same utterance. We therefore propose Speech-Rewarded Style Planning (SRSP), which trains a text-based style planner through a frozen downstream TTS model. Given dialogue history and response text, the planner generates candidate instructions and is optimized with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), using the teacher-forced likelihood of target speech tokens as the reward. On an English subset of the ISCSLP 2026 CoT-TTS corpus, SRSP achieves higher speech-style and emotion similarity to target speech and lower mel-cepstral distortion than the Base LLM and target-audio-informed captioning baselines. LLM-based expressive speech evaluation further shows gains over all baselines in contextual appropriateness and reference consistency.
articles.titleCn: 超越语音字幕：对话式文本转语音的语音奖励式风格规划
articles.abstractCn: 自然语言风格描述为大型语言模型（LLMs）和可控文本到语音（TTS）系统提供了一种可解释的接口。然而，将描述用作伪标签会将目标语音压缩成文本，而描述的保真度并不一定意味着能有效控制特定合成器。我们通过实验证明，对于同一语音片段，语音与文本的校准度仅微弱地预测了候选指令之间的下游语音相似性。因此，我们提出了语音奖励风格规划（SRSP），该方案通过冻结的下游TTS模型训练基于文本的风格规划器。给定对话历史和响应文本，规划器生成候选指令，并使用相对策略优化（GRPO）进行优化，以目标语音标记的教师强制似然度作为奖励。在ISCSLP 2026 CoT-TTS语料库的英语子集上，SRSP相较于基础LLM和目标音频信息引导的描述基线，实现了更高的语音风格和情感相似度，以及更低的梅尔倒谱失真。基于LLM的表达性语音评估进一步表明，在语境恰当性和参考一致性方面，SRSP均优于所有基线。

articles.title: SAIL: Scientific Agentic Intelligence via a Science-Aware Loop
articles.abstract: We introduce SAIL, an open model with 35B total and 3B active parameters for literature research, scientific coding, and multi-step research workflows. SAIL is developed through a science-aware improvement loop: agents built on frontier AI models analyze its task failures and construct training tasks that address the underlying capability gaps. The diagnosis examines search and evidence selection in literature tasks, scientific assumptions and reasoning in coding, and planning and revision in longer investigations. The agents draw on paper collections and scientific code repositories to build problems, interaction trajectories, and executable tasks with the required environments and tools. We repeat this loop over multiple development cycles and train SAIL through supervised fine-tuning, specialist training, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning. SAIL achieves competitive performance across scientific research tasks with substantially fewer parameters than leading open-weight models.
articles.titleCn: 基于科学感知循环的科学自主智能
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了SAIL，一个用于文献研究、科学编码和多步骤研究工作流的开放模型，其总参数量为35B，活跃参数量为3B。SAIL通过科学感知的改进循环开发而成：基于前沿AI模型的智能体分析其任务失败，并构建解决潜在能力差距的训练任务。诊断过程检查文献任务中的搜索和证据选择、编码中的科学假设和推理，以及长期调查中的规划和修订。智能体利用论文集合和科学代码仓库来构建问题、交互轨迹以及具有所需环境和工具的可执行任务。我们多次重复这个循环，并通过监督微调、专家训练、多导师策略蒸馏和智能体强化学习来训练SAIL。SAIL在科学研究任务中实现了具有竞争力的性能，其参数量远少于领先的开源权重模型。

articles.title: Adversarial Cues in Decision Models Used as Judges: The Role of Request Presentation
articles.abstract: An answer judge instructed to grade the final commitment should reject an explicitly wrong final value even when an earlier value matches the reference. We show that adding one colon to a candidate can violate this requirement depending on the presentation of the structured judging request. Numeric references certify the error, and paired interventions distinguish the candidate edit from the integration's presentation choices. On 200 previously unused DROP and GSM8K source clusters, the edit increased Jev's false acceptance from 1.0% to 26.0% with three output labels and from 3.0% to 26.5% with the published four-label grading instruction under sorted JSON keys. Both candidate variants were rejected under insertion presentation. These interactions passed the prespecified statistical correction even though Jev met the control thresholds under both grading configurations and presentations. Most excess acceptances occurred among candidates assigned larger numerical errors. GPT-6 Sol produced no observed cue-condition false acceptances, with missing responses unresolved. The result shows that basic judging competence can coexist with sharply different vulnerability to a fixed candidate edit across logically equivalent request presentations. The reference-aware grammar and compound ordering change limit the finding's operational scope and leave its internal cause unmeasured.
articles.titleCn: 用于决策模型的对抗性线索作为裁判：请求呈现的作用
articles.abstractCn: 一个负责评判最终承诺的答案裁判应当拒绝一个明确错误的最终值，即使一个较早的值与参考值匹配。我们表明，在候选答案中添加一个冒号可能违反这一要求，这取决于结构化评判请求的呈现方式。数值参考证实了错误，而配对的干预措施区分了候选答案的编辑与集成呈现选择。在200个先前未使用的DROP和GSM8K源集群上，该编辑将Jev的误接受率从1.0%增加到26.0%（使用三个输出标签）和从3.0%增加到26.5%（使用已发布的四标签评判指令，在排序的JSON键下）。在插入呈现方式下，这两种候选答案变体均被拒绝。尽管在两种评判配置和呈现方式下Jev均满足控制阈值，但这些交互通过了预设的统计校正。大多数多余的接受发生在被分配较大数值错误的候选答案中。GPT-6 Sol没有观察到与提示条件相关的误接受，缺失的响应尚未解决。结果表明，基本的评判能力可以与在逻辑等价的请求呈现方式下对固定候选答案编辑的显著不同脆弱性共存。参考感知语法和复合排序变化限制了该发现的操作范围，并使其内部原因未能被测量。

articles.title: BioBigBird: A Sparse Attention Model for Long-Range Dependency Processing in Biomedical Text
articles.abstract: While domain-specific Large Language Models (LLMs) have encoded vast biomedical knowledge, their limited context windows often hinder a deep understanding of nuanced relationships within and across texts. To address this limitation, we introduce BioBigBird, a bidirectional language model pre-trained on extensive biomedical literature and clinical data, specifically designed to handle long-range dependencies. BioBigBird leverages a sparse attention mechanism to process sequences up to 4096 tokens, and its training incorporates a multi-stage process to mitigate noise from the large-scale pre-training corpus. We further enhance its performance by employing a multi-task learning (MTL) framework that jointly optimizes for Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction. Comprehensive evaluations on the BLURB benchmark reveal that our MTL-enhanced BioBigBird achieves highly competitive results against state-of-the-art models. Our work contributes an effective methodology for developing powerful, long-context language models for specialized domains, demonstrating the value of extended sequence processing for complex text analysis. Our models are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/collections/bisectgroup/biobigbird.
articles.titleCn: BioBigBird：一种用于生物医学文本长距离依赖处理的稀疏注意力模型
articles.abstractCn: 尽管特定领域的巨型语言模型（LLMs）已编码了大量的生物医学知识，但它们有限的语言上下文窗口常常阻碍对文本内部和跨文本细微关系的深入理解。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了BioBigBird，这是一个在大量生物医学文献和临床数据上预训练的双向语言模型，专门设计用于处理长距离依赖关系。BioBigBird利用稀疏注意力机制处理长达4096个token的序列，其训练过程包含多阶段流程以减少大规模预训练语料库中的噪声。我们进一步通过采用多任务学习（MTL）框架来提升其性能，该框架联合优化了命名实体识别和关系抽取任务。在BLURB基准测试上的全面评估表明，我们的MTL增强型BioBigBird在性能上与当前最先进模型相比具有高度竞争力。我们的工作为开发适用于专业领域的强大长上下文语言模型提供了一种有效方法，证明了扩展序列处理对于复杂文本分析的价值。我们的模型可在https://huggingface.co/collections/bisectgroup/biobigbird公开获取。

articles.title: Fact over Fiction: Detection of Pathological Hallucinations in Sinhala-to-English Neural Machine Translation
articles.abstract: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) models, while capable of producing highly fluent outputs, remain vulnerable to hallucinations, which are translations that are natural yet semantically unrelated to the source. This vulnerability is acute in low-resource settings like Sinhala-to-English, where weak cross-lingual alignment leads to hallucinations. This paper introduces a framework for reference-free hallucination detection in this language pair. We present a 45,000-sample synthetic dataset generated through a probabilistic chain of five linguistically motivated corruption strategies, with a semantic rescue mechanism that uses character-level similarity to distinguish hallucinations from morphological variants. We fine-tune mDeBERTa-v3 for token-level sequence labelling, reaching a token-level F1 of 0.841 +/- 0.001 over three seeds on a source-disjoint test set, and study a three-signal ensemble integrating neural risk scores, sequence log-probabilities, and cross-lingual semantic embeddings (LaBSE). A source-ablation control shows that the detector relies on the Sinhala source rather than on surface artefacts of the corruption process: shuffling or removing the source reduces sentence-level AUROC from 0.970 to chance. We benchmark eight NMT systems spanning five model families and find that detector firings vary by an order of magnitude across architectures.
articles.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables, Accepted paper at the 13th Conference on Computational Linguistics and Speech Processing (ROCLING) 2026
articles.titleCn: 事实胜于虚构：在僧伽罗语到英语神经机器翻译中检测病理性幻觉
articles.abstractCn: 神经机器翻译（NMT）模型虽然能够生成高度流畅的输出，但仍然容易产生幻觉，即自然但与源语言在语义上无关的翻译。这种脆弱性在僧伽罗语-英语等低资源环境中尤为突出，因为薄弱的跨语言对齐会导致幻觉。本文介绍了一种针对这对语言的无参考幻觉检测框架。我们提出了一个包含45000个样本的合成数据集，该数据集通过五个基于语言学的损坏策略生成的概率链生成，并包含一个语义救援机制，该机制使用字符级相似度来区分幻觉和形态变体。我们对mDeBERTa-v3进行微调，用于标记级别的序列标注，在源语言不连续的测试集上，三个种子达到了0.841 +/- 0.001的标记级别F1值，并研究了集成神经风险分数、序列对数概率和跨语言语义嵌入（LaBSE）的三信号集成方法。源语言消融控制实验表明，该检测器依赖于僧伽罗语源，而不是损坏过程中的表面伪影：打乱或移除源语言会降低句子级别的AUROC从0.970降至随机水平。我们对八个跨越五个模型系列的NMT系统进行了基准测试，发现检测器的触发频率在不同架构之间差异达一个数量级。

articles.title: From a Prompt to Repertoires: Evolving Functional REpertoires Enable LLM Continual Learning
articles.abstract: Continual learning remains challenging for large language models, which must enable models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. Existing approaches typically address this challenge by carefully designing how model parameters are updated. In contrast, prompt optimization avoids costly parameter updates while achieving competitive or even superior performance to reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO on individual knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks. This raises a natural question: \textit{Can prompt optimization, as an efficient adaptation approach, be directly applied to continual learning?} Our analysis shows that, under sequential task adaptation, it suffers from catastrophic forgetting, while optimized prompts accumulate rules that overfit to local task distributions. To address these limitations, we propose \emph{Evolving Functional REpertoires} (EFRE), which replaces a single prompt with a repertoire of functions that evolves as new tasks arrive: compatible updates refine existing functions, while conflicting updates trigger the emergence of new ones. On a three-task continual-learning stream, EFRE achieves a final average performance 7.50 percentage points higher than GRPO. Moreover, after adaptation to the Bio task, its performance on FinQA decreases by only 1.56 percentage points, compared with 25.10 percentage points for the base prompt optimization method. We further instantiate EFRE in a minimal agent system and observe consistent improvements across different backbone models. Overall, these results demonstrate EFRE's strong performance in continual learning for large language models and highlight its substantial potential for continual learning in advanced agent systems.
articles.titleCn: 从提示到曲库：进化的功能曲库使大型语言模型实现持续学习
articles.abstractCn: 持续学习对大型语言模型来说仍然是一个挑战，这要求模型能够在不降低现有能力的情况下获取新技能和知识。现有方法通常通过精心设计模型参数的更新方式来应对这一挑战。相比之下，提示优化避免了昂贵的参数更新，同时在个体知识密集型和推理任务上实现了与强化学习方法（如GRPO）相当甚至更优的性能。这自然引出了一个问题：作为一种高效的适应方法，提示优化能否直接应用于持续学习？我们的分析表明，在顺序任务适应下，它存在灾难性遗忘的问题，而优化的提示会积累过度拟合局部任务分布的规则。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了\emph{进化功能曲库}（EFRE），它用一组随着新任务到来而进化的函数来替代单个提示：兼容的更新会优化现有函数，而冲突的更新则会触发新函数的出现。在一个三任务持续学习流上，EFRE最终的平均性能比GRPO高出7.50个百分点。此外，在适应Bio任务后，其在FinQA上的性能仅下降1.56个百分点，而基础提示优化方法的性能下降了25.10个百分点。我们进一步在最小智能体系统中实例化EFRE，并观察到在不同主干模型上的一致性能提升。总体而言，这些结果证明了EFRE在大型语言模型的持续学习方面的强大性能，并突出了其在高级智能体系统持续学习方面的巨大潜力。

articles.title: SignRAG: Unified Retrieval-Augmented Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
articles.abstract: Contemporary decoder-only large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of domains. However, existing pretraining paradigms for gloss-free sign language translation (SLT) are largely designed around conventional encoder-decoder pretrained language models, which limits their direct applicability to decoder-only LLMs. To address this limitation, we propose SignRAG, a unified framework combining hierarchical pretraining, target-domain retrieval augmentation, and retrieval-aware reinforcement fine-tuning. Hierarchical pretraining first learns linguistically grounded sign representations and then jointly aligns the sign encoder with an LLM, mitigating cross-modal optimization imbalance. For downstream adaptation, SignRAG complements parameter-based fine-tuning with a target-domain retrieval gallery that provides instance-specific translation cues. To ensure that retrieved contexts are used appropriately, we further introduce Retrieval Utility-Guided Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RUG-RFT), which combines translation-quality and retrieval-utility rewards to encourage beneficial retrieval use while suppressing harmful reliance. Experiments on multiple SLT benchmarks establish new state-of-the-art performance. In particular, to the best of our knowledge, SignRAG is the first gloss-free approach to outperform gloss-supervised methods across all reported metrics on CSL-Daily. Our code has been released at \href{https://github.com/shahelaojieraozhi/SignRAG}{GitHub}, together with models of different sizes to support future academic research.
articles.titleCn: SignRAG：统一检索增强的无注释手语翻译
articles.abstractCn: 当代的仅解码器大型语言模型（LLMs）在众多领域展现出强大的能力。然而，现有的无注释手语翻译（SLT）预训练范式主要围绕传统的编码器-解码器预训练语言模型设计，这限制了它们直接应用于仅解码器LLMs。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了SignRAG，一个结合了分层预训练、目标领域检索增强和检索感知强化微调的统一框架。分层预训练首先学习基于语言的符号表示，然后联合对齐符号编码器与LLM，缓解跨模态优化不平衡问题。对于下游适配，SignRAG通过提供实例特定翻译提示的目标领域检索图库来补充基于参数的微调。为确保检索到的上下文得到适当使用，我们进一步引入了检索效用引导强化微调（RUG-RFT），该技术结合了翻译质量和检索效用奖励，鼓励有益的检索使用并抑制有害的依赖。在多个SLT基准测试上的实验确立了新的最先进性能。特别是，据我们所知，SignRAG是首个在CSL-Daily所有报告指标上超越注释监督方法的无注释方法。我们的代码已发布在GitHub上，并提供了不同大小的模型以支持未来的学术研究。

articles.title: UniData: Universal Multimodal Instruction Generation Pipeline
articles.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly being applied in a wider range of real-world scenarios. However, due to the substantial labor cost, creating high-quality multimodal instruction datasets for MLLMs remains a significant challenge. Although some methods propose to generate instruction data, they often face limitations in modality support and struggle with generating multi-round instructions. To address these problems, we introduce UniData, a universal instruction generation pipeline, to transform simple user requirements into multi-round, multimodal instructions. Specifically, UniData first expands user requirements into multiple diverse events. Using these events, UniData then integrates an any-to-any large model for multimodal instruction generation. Finally, UniData enhances data quality by correcting irrelevant and redundant inference flow, leveraging correlations between instruction rounds. To train this pipeline, we also build UniDataset, a dataset comprising 20,000 entries across nine modalities for improved multimodal generation. Our experiments demonstrate that UniData achieves SOTA performance in data quality and can also enhance the understanding and generation capabilities of other multimodal models.
articles.titleCn: UniData：通用多模态指令生成流程
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）正越来越多地应用于更广泛的现实场景中。然而，由于巨大的劳动成本，为MLLMs创建高质量的多模态指令数据集仍然是一个重大挑战。尽管一些方法提出了生成指令数据，但它们通常在模态支持方面存在局限，并难以生成多轮指令。为解决这些问题，我们引入了UniData，一个通用的指令生成管道，用于将简单的用户需求转换为多轮、多模态指令。具体而言，UniData首先将用户需求扩展为多个多样化的事件。利用这些事件，UniData接着整合任意到任意的多模态大型模型进行指令生成。最后，UniData通过纠正无关和冗余的推理流程，利用指令轮次之间的关联性来提升数据质量。为训练该管道，我们还构建了UniDataset，这是一个包含九种模态、20,000条条目的数据集，以提升多模态生成能力。我们的实验表明，UniData在数据质量方面达到了SOTA性能，并且还能提升其他多模态模型的理解和生成能力。

articles.title: AdaptEvo: Adaptive Agent Learning with Evolving Supervision
articles.abstract: Rule-governed contextual decision tasks require models to apply specified rules to case-specific context and evidence. Written rules can leave gaps in decision guidance and process evaluation, while reference judgments vary in their support from the rules and evidence. To address these challenges, we introduce AdaptEvo, a framework for learning under imperfect supervision that couples confidence-adaptive policy optimization with evolving decision knowledge and evaluation rubrics. Its Training module uses Confidence-Adaptive GRPO (CA-GRPO) to balance outcome and process rewards according to reference confidence. Its Evolution module synthesizes reusable decision knowledge from recurring failures across training cases and refines process rubrics to detect overlooked errors. To support empirical evaluation, we construct an industrial multimodal content moderation dataset comprising a training set and In-Period and Out-of-Period test sets, with the latter collected under changed rules. Using Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, AdaptEvo achieves 61.9% exact-label accuracy and 72.2% binary decision accuracy on In-Period, exceeding GRPO by 7.5 and 3.7 percentage points, respectively. On Out-of-Period, the policy trained with CA-GRPO retains exact-label accuracy gains over the base model across evaluated checkpoints without injected decision knowledge, while GRPO declines with continued training. CA-GRPO also outperforms the tested fixed reward mixtures on both Out-of-Period metrics.
articles.titleCn: AdaptEvo：进化式监督下的自适应智能体学习
articles.abstractCn: 受规则约束的情境决策任务要求模型将特定规则应用于案例特定的情境和证据。书面规则可能在决策指导和流程评估中存在空白，而参考判断在规则和证据支持方面存在差异。为应对这些挑战，我们引入了AdaptEvo框架，该框架结合了置信度自适应策略优化和演化的决策知识与评估标准，用于在非完美监督下进行学习。其训练模块采用置信度自适应GRPO（CA-GRPO）根据参考置信度平衡结果和流程奖励。其演化模块从训练案例中反复出现的失败中综合可重用的决策知识，并细化流程评估标准以检测被忽略的错误。为支持实证评估，我们构建了一个工业多模态内容审核数据集，包含训练集和期内及期外测试集，后者在规则变更下收集。使用Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型，AdaptEvo在期内测试中实现了61.9%的精确标签准确率和72.2%的二分类决策准确率，分别比GRPO高7.5和3.7个百分点。在期外测试中，使用CA-GRPO训练的策略在未注入决策知识的情况下，在所有评估检查点均保持了比基础模型更高的精确标签准确率，而GRPO则随着持续训练而下降。CA-GRPO在期外测试的两个指标上均优于测试中的固定奖励组合。

articles.title: RL-ARC: Calibrating Large Reasoning Models via Reasoning-guided Uncertainty
articles.abstract: Language models (LMs) are commonly trained with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to enhance their reasoning capabilities. However, since RLVR does not explicitly account for calibration during training, it can lead to severe calibration degradation, including overconfidence. Recent calibration-aware training methods for LMs, which incorporate objectives for uncertainty estimation into training, improve calibration but still exhibit overconfidence under distribution shift, while sacrificing reasoning performance. To this end, we propose RL-ARC, a calibration-aware training framework that jointly leverages reasoning confidence and answer confidence. Specifically, RL-ARC leverages reasoning confidence as an auxiliary signal for calibrating answer confidence, applying it as reasoning-guided regularization for correct cases and as an overconfidence penalty for incorrect cases. Comprehensive results across ID and OOD settings show that, beyond improving calibration, RL-ARC enables reasoning models to adaptively estimate confidence based on the given question without substantially sacrificing reasoning performance, thereby highlighting the importance of reasoning confidence for training reliable reasoning models.
articles.titleCn: RL-ARC：通过推理引导的不确定性对大型推理模型进行校准
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型（LMs）通常通过可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）进行训练，以增强其推理能力。然而，由于RLVR在训练过程中没有明确考虑校准，它可能导致严重的校准退化，包括过度自信。最近提出的针对LMs的校准感知训练方法，将不确定性估计目标纳入训练中，虽然提高了校准度，但在分布偏移下仍然表现出过度自信，同时牺牲了推理性能。为此，我们提出了RL-ARC，这是一个校准感知训练框架，它联合利用推理置信度和答案置信度。具体而言，RL-ARC利用推理置信度作为校准答案置信度的辅助信号，将其应用于正确情况下的推理引导正则化，以及作为错误情况下的过度自信惩罚。跨ID和OOD设置的综合结果表明，除了提高校准度之外，RL-ARC使推理模型能够根据给定问题自适应地估计置信度，而不会显著牺牲推理性能，从而突出了推理置信度对于训练可靠推理模型的重要性。

articles.title: Deception by Omission: Language Models Knowingly Hide Their Mistakes
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as agents with little human oversight, so potential mistakes they make can go unnoticed. Users then depend on the model to report what went wrong. An honest model discloses its mistakes, while a deceptive one conceals them. However, it is unclear how current LLMs behave in such situations. In this study, we prefill LLM trajectories with synthetic mistakes. The trajectories resemble real deployments in chat and agentic settings. Models fail to disclose their mistake in 36.4% of chat and 67.1% of agentic rollouts. In 2.4% and 5.3% of rollouts, respectively, they are aware of the mistake in their chain of thought but still deceptively conceal it. Rates vary by model: for instance, Gemini 3.5 Flash knowingly conceals mistakes in up to 19.9% of agentic rollouts. In 11.9% of chat and 51.8% of agentic rollouts, models show no awareness of mistakes, even though they reliably spot them when reviewing the same transcript as an outside observer. Our results show that, as agents take on more tasks with less oversight, users cannot rely on them to self-report possible mistakes. Developers should instead use independent monitors that review agent trajectories, or specifically train models to check their past actions and disclose what they find.
articles.titleCn: 隐瞒式欺骗：语言模型故意隐藏其错误
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地以人类监督极少的方式充当代理，因此它们可能犯的错误可能未被察觉。用户随后依赖模型来报告问题所在。诚实的模型会披露其错误，而欺骗性的模型则会隐瞒。然而，目前尚不清楚当前的LLMs在这种情况下会如何表现。在本研究中，我们向LLM轨迹中预填入合成错误。这些轨迹类似于聊天和代理环境中的实际部署。在36.4%的聊天和67.1%的代理展开中，模型未能披露其错误。在2.4%和5.3%的展开中，它们意识到其思维链中的错误，但仍然欺骗性地隐瞒。比率因模型而异：例如，Gemini 3.5 Flash在高达19.9%的代理展开中明知隐瞒错误。在11.9%的聊天和51.8%的代理展开中，模型表现出对错误的毫无意识，尽管它们在作为外部观察者审阅相同文本时能够可靠地发现错误。我们的结果表明，随着代理承担更多任务且监督减少，用户不能依赖它们自我报告可能的错误。开发者应使用独立的监控器来审查代理轨迹，或专门训练模型以检查其过去的行为并披露其发现。

articles.title: Type-Checking for Pattern-Based Tree Transformations
articles.abstract: We introduce and study pattern-based tree transformations. As an illustrating example, consider a source pattern $(x \cdot y) + (x \cdot z)$ and a target pattern $x \cdot (y + z)$ as a pair. This source pattern matches any expression $e$ of the form $(e_1 \cdot e_2) + (e_1 \cdot e_3)$ (by substituting $x$ with $e_1$, $y$ with $e_2$, and $z$ with $e_3$) and the pair transforms it into the expression $e_1 \cdot (e_2 + e_3)$ as dictated by the target pattern. Note that in this example, the set of expressions that match the source pattern is not a regular tree language. We propose a model of tree transformations given by a finite representation of a (possibly infinite) set of such (source pattern, target pattern) pairs. The expressive power of this model comes at the cost of undecidability of checking equivalence. Nevertheless, we show that the type-checking problem is decidable for our model of pattern-based tree transformations. The type-checking problem asks whether applying a given transformation to trees having a given regular property (type) preserves the property. Our decision procedure is by a reduction to the emptiness problem of alternating tree automata.
