articles.titleCn: 基于模式的树转换的类型检查
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍并研究了基于模式的树变换。作为一个说明性的例子，考虑源模式 $(x \cdot y) + (x \cdot z)$ 和目标模式 $x \cdot (y + z)$ 作为一对。这个源模式匹配任何形式为 $(e_1 \cdot e_2) + (e_1 \cdot e_3)$ 的表达式 $e$（通过将 $x$ 替换为 $e_1$，$y$ 替换为 $e_2$，$z$ 替换为 $e_3$），并且这一对将其转换为根据目标模式得到的表达式 $e_1 \cdot (e_2 + e_3)$。请注意，在这个例子中，匹配源模式的表达式集合不是正则树语言。我们提出了一个树变换模型，该模型由一个（可能是无限的）这样的（源模式，目标模式）对集合的有限表示给出。这个模型的表达能力以检查等价性的不可判定性为代价。尽管如此，我们证明了在我们的基于模式的树变换模型中，类型检查问题是可判定的。类型检查问题询问是否将给定的变换应用于具有给定正则属性（类型）的树能够保持该属性。我们的决策过程是通过将其归约到交替树自动机的空集问题。

articles.title: ReCal: Calibrating Structured Pruning for On-Policy Distillation Recovery
articles.abstract: Structured pruning reduces the deployment cost of reasoning language models, but the resulting capability degradation can hinder subsequent on-policy distillation (OPD) recovery. Because OPD relies on student-generated trajectories, pruning damage that persists after offline distillation can limit its effectiveness. We propose RECAL, Recovery-Aware Calibration, a simple plug-and-play approach that improves OPD recovery by adjusting calibration before pruning. RECAL uses forward KL between an unpruned teacher and a pruned probe to identify teacher-supported predictions disrupted by pruning, then reweights calibration statistics to guide existing pruning criteria toward preserving these predictions. Across multiple models and pruning methods, RECAL consistently improves mathematical reasoning after OPD, achieving gains of up to 16.7 percentage points on AIME, alongside improvements in most code-generation comparisons. Further analysis shows that RECAL reduces residual damage at heavily affected tokens and establishes performance advantages that persist through recovery. These results demonstrate the value of recovery-aware calibration for improving on-policy distillation recovery of pruned reasoning models.
articles.titleCn: ReCal：用于策略蒸馏恢复的结构化剪枝校准
articles.abstractCn: 结构化剪枝降低了推理语言模型的部署成本，但由此产生的性能退化可能会阻碍后续的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）恢复。由于OPD依赖于学生生成的轨迹，离线蒸馏后持续存在的剪枝损伤会限制其有效性。我们提出了RECAL，即恢复感知校准，这是一种简单的即插即用方法，通过在剪枝前调整校准来提高OPD恢复效果。RECAL利用未剪枝教师模型与剪枝探测模型之间的正向KL散度来识别被剪枝破坏的教师模型支持的预测，然后重新加权校准统计量，以指导现有的剪枝标准保留这些预测。在多个模型和剪枝方法上，RECAL始终如一地提高了OPD后的数学推理能力，在AIME上实现了高达16.7个百分点的提升，同时在大多数代码生成比较中也取得了改进。进一步分析表明，RECAL减少了受严重影响标记的残余损伤，并建立了在恢复过程中持续存在的性能优势。这些结果证明了恢复感知校准对于提高剪枝推理模型的在线策略蒸馏恢复价值的重要性。

articles.title: MetaEncoder: Exploring the Limit of Bi-Encoders for Multimodal System One Decision Making with Natural Language Interface
articles.abstract: System One models output constrained decisions and probability distributions rather than free-form text generation. While prevailing paradigms rely on structured schema objects to encode state, intent, and candidate choices, we revisit a fully natural language-based System One interface. In this framework, both the user request and each candidate option are expressed in natural language, supported by multimodal (image and video) auxiliary inputs. We introduce MetaEncoder, which fine-tunes a pre-trained Muse-Glimmer 30B decoder into an instruction-following decision-making encoder. To scale effectively across both small closed-set (< 256) and massive open-set (millions) candidate spaces, MetaEncoder employs a bi-encoder architecture trained via unidirectional contrastive learning for request-candidate alignment. We conduct extensive evaluations across 11 benchmark suites and 190 tasks spanning multimodal decision-making, understanding (closed-set) and retrieval (open-set), highlighting where MetaEncoder beats SOTA multimodal encoders, as well as its current limits on reasoning-intensive tasks.
articles.titleCn: MetaEncoder：探索多模态系统一决策的自然语言界面中双编码器的极限
articles.abstractCn: 系统一模型输出受限决策和概率分布，而非自由形式的文本生成。尽管主流范式依赖结构化模式对象来编码状态、意图和候选选择，我们重新审视了基于完全自然语言的系统一界面。在此框架中，用户请求和每个候选选项均以自然语言表达，并辅以多模态（图像和视频）辅助输入。我们引入了MetaEncoder，将预训练的Muse-Glimmer 30B解码器微调为指令跟随决策编码器。为在小规模封闭集（<256）和大规模开放集（数百万）候选空间中有效扩展，MetaEncoder采用双编码器架构，通过单向对比学习进行请求-候选对齐训练。我们在11套基准测试和190项涵盖多模态决策、理解（封闭集）和检索（开放集）的任务中进行了广泛评估，突显了MetaEncoder超越SOTA多模态编码器之处，以及其在推理密集型任务上的当前局限性。

articles.title: From Retrieval to Reconstruction: Constructing Evolvable Cognitive Memory for Long-Term Dialogue
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) serving as long-term dialogue agents require memory systems that support reliable reasoning over extended interactions. However, existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks typically treat memory as passive storage, making it difficult to distinguish source-attributed beliefs from unattributed event/fact records and to connect evidence dispersed across sessions. We introduce CogMem, a cognitive memory architecture based on the PEC$^2$F (Person-Event-Concept-Claim-Fact) graph schema. Dedicated Claim nodes preserve the source and target of subjective statements, while Fact and Event nodes represent semantic and episodic knowledge. Dialogue turns are incrementally converted into provenance-aware graph records, consolidated into higher-level facts, and reconciled into temporally scoped Claim views when the same source provides conflicting updates. For retrieval, a rule-based controller driven by LLM intent parsing composes four deterministic graph operators---anchoring, traversal, intersection, and evidence grounding---to reconstruct query-relevant context. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show strong performance, especially on multi-hop, temporal, and knowledge-update tasks. Ablations and a semantic-collapse probe support complementary contributions from epistemic separation, consolidation, and agentic retrieval. Code: https://github.com/Silent-Rain02/CogMem.
articles.titleCn: 从检索到重建：构建可进化的认知记忆以支持长期对话
articles.abstractCn: 作为长期对话代理的大型语言模型（LLMs）需要支持跨长时间交互的可靠推理的内存系统。然而，现有的检索增强生成（RAG）框架通常将内存视为被动存储，这使得难以区分来源归属的信念与未归属的事件/事实记录，也难以连接分散在会话中的证据。我们引入了CogMem，一种基于PEC$^2$F（人物-事件-概念-主张-事实）图模式的认知记忆架构。专门的主张节点保存主观陈述的来源和目标，而事实和事件节点表示语义和情景知识。对话轮次被逐步转换为具有来源意识的图记录，整合为更高级别的事实，并在同一来源提供冲突更新时协调为具有时间范围的视图。对于检索，一个由LLM意图解析驱动的基于规则的控制器组合了四个确定性图操作符——锚定、遍历、交集和证据接地——以重建与查询相关的上下文。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验显示出优异的性能，特别是在多跳、时间和知识更新任务上。消融实验和语义折叠探测支持了认知分离、整合和代理检索的互补贡献。代码：https://github.com/Silent-Rain02/CogMem。

articles.title: BeliefScope: Diagnosing Evidence-Driven Revision and Pressure-Induced Shifts in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: A language model may revise the same proposition after receiving genuinely relevant evidence or after receiving directional user pressure that adds no relevant fact. The observable response shift alone therefore does not reveal which source drove the change. We introduce BeliefScope, a controlled black-box framework for separating these two sources of influence around a fixed target proposition. BeliefScope crosses Evidence and Pressure with factor-specific local controls and measures response changes through probability reports, categorical judgments, and action recommendations on channel-appropriate scales. To determine when these observable contrasts support reliable attribution, we evaluate the observation design under controlled synthetic conditions. Known-truth recovery and targeted ablations establish where Evidence- and Pressure-related effects can be separated, while semi-synthetic stress tests map how that recoverability changes as the observation process becomes noisier and more heterogeneous. Across a 36-family Qwen/Llama study, with targeted 12-family checks that also include Gemma3-12B, the resulting profiles show substantial evaluation-context dependence: broad model-level differences can change under matched controls, decoding, or response interfaces, while some narrower within-model patterns remain stable. Instruction interventions further show that reduced target-aligned Pressure following can reflect either stable resistance or movement in the opposite direction. BeliefScope summarizes these measurements as a conditional belief-response profile that keeps diagnostic effects tied to the evaluation conditions under which they are observed, together with explicit validity boundaries for that diagnosis.
articles.titleCn: BeliefScope：诊断大型语言模型中证据驱动修正和压力诱导偏移
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型在接收到真正相关的证据或接收到不增加相关事实的方向性用户压力后，可能会修正同一个命题。因此，仅凭可观察到的响应变化并不能揭示是哪个来源驱动了这种变化。我们引入了BeliefScope，这是一个用于分离围绕固定目标命题的这两种影响因素的受控黑盒框架。BeliefScope通过证据和压力的交叉，结合特定因素的局部控制，并通过概率报告、分类判断以及在不同渠道上合适的行动建议来测量响应变化。为了确定这些可观察到的对比何时支持可靠的归因，我们在受控的合成条件下评估了观察设计。已知真相的恢复和有针对性的消融实验确定了证据相关和压力相关效应可以分离的界限，而半合成压力测试则描绘了随着观察过程变得越嘈杂和异质，这种可恢复性如何变化。在一个包含36个Qwen/Llama家族的实验研究中，其中包括12个有针对性的检查（也包括Gemma3-12B），结果分析表明评估上下文具有很大的依赖性：广泛的模型级差异在匹配控制、解码或响应界面下可能会发生变化，而一些较窄的模型内部模式则保持稳定。指令干预进一步表明，随后的目标对齐压力减少可能反映了稳定的抵抗或向相反方向的变化。BeliefScope将这些测量结果总结为一个条件信念响应配置文件，该配置文件将诊断效应与其被观察到的评估条件绑定在一起，并提供了该诊断的明确有效性边界。

articles.title: When Do We Need On-Policy Distillation? Distilling on Offline Student Rollouts Is Often Better
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become increasingly popular for transferring teacher capabilities to student models. In this work, we ask a critical research question: Is on-policy sampling always beneficial for distilling arbitrary teacher-student pairs? We show that a simple alternative, Semi-OPD, which distills from offline rollouts generated by the initial student, can often outperform OPD in both accuracy and training efficiency. Across 17 teacher-student pairs ranging from 1.5B to 235B parameters, Semi-OPD outperforms OPD in 14 cases, with up to +13.6% accuracy and 11.4x training speedup. We further find that the choice between OPD and Semi-OPD depends on the alignment between the initial teacher and student, quantified by an output-token overlap ratio: OPD is beneficial only when the two are highly aligned with high overlap ratios. Our deeper investigation suggests that effective distillation requires on-policyness w.r.t. both the student and the teacher. For misaligned pairs, student rollouts can become increasingly off-policy w.r.t. the teacher as context length grows, weakening the distillation signal. In contrast, Semi-OPD is often more stable, as it distills on shorter contexts while covering full trajectories and exposing the student to more teacher-preferred tokens. Beyond proposing Semi-OPD as an efficient alternative, our work motivates the community to rethink when to use OPD and to study stronger OPD variants with meaningful teacher-student pairs.
articles.titleCn: 什么时候我们需要在线策略蒸馏？通常在离线学生策略部署上进行蒸馏更好
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）已成为将教师模型能力迁移至学生模型的一种日益流行的技术。在本工作中，我们提出了一个关键的研究问题：策略内采样是否始终有利于蒸馏任意教师-学生模型对？我们展示了一种简单的替代方案——半策略内蒸馏（Semi-OPD），它从初始学生生成的离线回放中蒸馏信息，这种方案在准确性和训练效率方面通常优于OPD。在涵盖参数量从1.5B到235B的17对教师-学生模型中，Semi-OPD在14个案例中表现优于OPD，准确率提升高达+13.6%，训练速度提升高达11.4倍。我们进一步发现，OPD与Semi-OPD的选择取决于初始教师与学生之间的对齐程度，该对齐程度通过输出标记重叠率进行量化：只有当两者高度对齐且重叠率较高时，OPD才有益。我们的深入研究表明，有效的蒸馏要求相对于学生和教师都保持策略内性。对于未对齐的模型对，随着上下文长度的增加，学生回放会越来越偏离教师策略，从而削弱蒸馏信号。相比之下，Semi-OPD通常更稳定，因为它在较短的上下文中蒸馏，同时覆盖完整轨迹，并让学生接触更多教师偏好的标记。除了提出Semi-OPD作为一种高效的替代方案外，我们的工作还激励社区重新思考何时使用OPD，并研究具有更有意义教师-学生模型对的更强OPD变体。

articles.title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction
articles.abstract: Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.
articles.titleCn: REMORY：学习残差记忆以实现上下文压缩
articles.abstractCn: 长时程代理通过压缩历史信息以在有限上下文窗口内继续执行，但仅有的文本摘要可能无法支持后续的每一个决策。我们引入了REMORY，一种神经记忆网络，它通过一个有界的软记忆标记序列来补充摘要。给定历史信息和摘要，该网络学习生成有助于冻结的大型语言模型（LLM）近似其使用完整历史信息时所产生的延续的标记。这些标记基于摘要生成，并追加到摘要之后，沿着序列维度形成类似残差连接的结构。在SummHay数据集上，REMORY在几乎不变的洞察覆盖度下提升了源归因能力，并仅使用5.2%的输入位置就接近了完整上下文的联合得分。在长时程代理基准测试中，Qwen3.8-27B和GLM-5.3-Flash模型在引入残差记忆后均表现出持续的性能提升。此外，这两个模型在BrowseComp和Terminal-Bench 2.1测试中也显著减少了重复的工具输出和工具错误。

articles.title: Phonological Interference in Multilingual Speech Models
articles.abstract: Phoneme-level models transcribe or generate speech as a sequence of phonemes, the smallest sound units that distinguish words. These models enable fine-grained pronunciation control and understanding, yet often fail on input that does not match any single training language, such as speech alternating between two languages, known as code-switching, or low-resource languages absent from training. We identify a systematic failure mode behind this, phonological interference: models assume the input is in a single language and impose its phonology, overriding local phoneme-level decisions that conflict with the assumed language. We measure interference by how often a model retains phonemes that one language has but the other lacks. On code-switched input, two phone recognizers (speech-to-phoneme models) and a phoneme-conditioned text-to-speech model lose 32% to 79% of these phonemes, but lose far fewer of the phonemes both languages share. On unseen languages, we find that phone recognizers impose the phonology of the training language they assign to the speech, and the more confident the assignment, the more they lose phonemes the unseen language has but the assigned language lacks. We probe the models' language estimate from their internal activations, and trace interference to a low dimensional subspace. On monolingual speech, steering this subspace toward another language makes the model lose the phonemes that only the original language uses and produce phonemes that only the target language has. We introduce windowed language estimation (WLE), an inference time repair that replaces the model's language estimate in this subspace with one computed from a short window around each position. On code-switched input, WLE removes 34% to 69% of the interference in all three models, and in the recognizers it leaves monolingual performance essentially unchanged.
articles.titleCn: 多语种语音模型中的语音学干扰
articles.abstractCn: 音素级模型将语音转录或生成为一连串音素，即区分单词的最小音素单位。这些模型能够实现精细的发音控制和理解，但在输入与任何单一训练语言不匹配的情况下，如两种语言交替出现的语音（称为语码转换）或训练数据中缺失的低资源语言，往往表现不佳。我们识别出这种系统性失效模式背后的原因——语音干扰：模型假设输入属于单一语言，并强加该语言的语音系统，从而覆盖与假设语言冲突的局部音素级决策。我们通过模型保留一种语言有而另一种语言没有的音素的频率来衡量干扰程度。在语码转换输入中，两个电话识别器（语音到音素的模型）和一个音素条件文本到语音模型丢失了这些音素的32%到79%，但丢失的共享音素远少得多。对于未见过语言，我们发现电话识别器会强加其分配给语音的训练语言的语音系统，且分配越自信，丢失的未见过语言有而分配语言没有的音素就越多。我们从模型内部激活中探测其语言估计，并将干扰追踪到一个低维子空间。在单语语音中，将此子空间引导至另一种语言，使模型丢失原始语言独有的音素并生成目标语言独有的音素。我们引入了窗口语言估计（WLE），这是一种推理时修复方法，用从每个位置周围短窗口计算出的估计值替换模型在此子空间中的语言估计。在语码转换输入中，WLE消除了所有三种模型中34%到69%的干扰，且在识别器中，其单语性能基本保持不变。

articles.title: Gated Memory: Admission-Controlled Memory Formation for Conversational AI
articles.abstract: Personalized conversational AI relies on long-term memory systems that extract facts from user utterances and store them in persistent vector stores. Despite progress in retrieval, deduplication, and lifecycle management, the formation stage, the moment a fact is first written to storage has received almost no principled attention. We identify this as the binding constraint on memory quality in production systems. Critical contextual signals, such as the distinction between a permanent user attribute and a transient situation, exist only in the original utterance and are irreversibly lost the moment extraction produces a subject-relation-object triple. No downstream process can recover them. We propose Gated Memory, a lightweight, modular formation framework that interposes two decision checkpoints between conversation and storage: an admission gate that evaluates every candidate fact against the full utterance context before extraction runs, and a conditional enrichment stage that grounds admitted facts through an entity scope taxonomy with privacy constraints. The gate evaluates only the current exchange while using prior turns as read-only reference context, and produces a structured formation record. Admitted content is decomposed into atomic facts, each categorized, tagged with provenance (directly stated versus inferred), scoped to its condition of applicability, and grounded in resolved time and place, subject to a constraint that no entity absent from the context may be asserted. On the LoCoMo-10 benchmark with atypical emotional density in utterance data, Gated Memory achieves an overall +2.6% relative improvement in LLM-judge accuracy over a strong baseline with identical retrieval and generation, establishing formation quality as a measurable constraint on memory performance.
articles.titleCn: 门控记忆：用于对话式AI的准入控制记忆形成
articles.abstractCn: 个性化对话式AI依赖于长期记忆系统，这些系统从用户话语中提取事实并存储在持久化向量存储中。尽管在检索、去重和生命周期管理方面取得了进展，但事实形成阶段——即事实首次写入存储的时刻——几乎未得到任何原则性关注。我们将其识别为生产系统中记忆质量的关键约束。关键上下文信号，例如永久用户属性与瞬时情境之间的区别，仅存在于原始话语中，一旦提取生成主谓宾三元组就会永久丢失，下游任何流程都无法恢复。我们提出了Gated Memory，这是一个轻量级、模块化的形成框架，在对话与存储之间插入两个决策检查点：一个在提取运行前，根据完整话语上下文评估每个候选事实的准入门；一个条件性增强阶段，通过受隐私约束的实体范围分类体系对准入事实进行锚定。准入门仅评估当前交互，同时将先前回合作为只读参考上下文，并生成结构化形成记录。准入内容被分解为原子事实，每个事实都进行分类，标记来源（直接陈述或推断），限定其适用条件，并在解析的时间和地点中锚定，同时遵守约束条件：上下文中未出现的实体不得被断言。在LoCoMo-10基准测试中，该基准测试的话语数据具有非典型的情感密度，Gated Memory在检索和生成与强基线相同的情况下，LLM裁判准确率相对提升了2.6%，确立了形成质量作为记忆性能的可衡量约束。

articles.title: Why On-Policy Distillation Sometimes Fails: Vanishing Learning Signals
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) enables effective capability transfer between language models, yet the mechanisms underlying its failures are not fully understood. Across code generation and mathematical reasoning, OPD with larger-scale teachers exhibits early loss plateaus, with an average final loss reduction of 25.1% after 200 updates, compared with 96.2% for self-RL teachers, obtained by further reinforcement learning (RL) training of the initial student. To understand this difference, we analyze OPD as an idealized continuous-time dynamical system in the small-learning-rate limit. Our training-log diagnostics associate these plateaus with an early decline in a gradient-based learning-signal proxy while substantial loss remains; these measurements do not establish why the underlying gradient weakens. We further prove a local recovery guarantee for teachers sufficiently close to the initial student in a shared parameterization under regularity conditions, offering a conditional explanation for the success of self-RL teachers in our experiments. Across runs with and without loss plateaus, we observe small relative parameter changes (0.025-0.098%) and high similarity between the student's representations before and after OPD (linear CKA $>0.98$ across layers). These observations suggest that limited representation adaptation may contribute to learning-signal collapse, a hypothesis that remains to be tested. Code is available at https://github.com/leizhao7/opd-learning-signals.
articles.titleCn: 为什么策略蒸馏有时会失败：学习信号消失
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）能够有效地在语言模型之间进行能力迁移，但其失败机制尚未完全理解。在代码生成和数学推理任务中，规模更大的教师模型表现出早期损失平台现象，在200次更新后，平均最终损失降低了25.1%，而通过进一步强化学习（RL）训练初始学生模型获得的自我RL教师则降低了96.2%。为了理解这种差异，我们将OPD分析为在小学习率极限下的理想化连续时间动力系统。我们的训练日志诊断将这些平台现象与基于梯度的学习信号代理的早期下降相关联，同时损失仍然显著；这些测量并未揭示为什么底层梯度会减弱。我们进一步在正则条件下，证明了在共享参数化下足够接近初始学生的教师模型具有局部恢复保证，为实验中自我RL教师成功提供了条件性解释。在有无损失平台的不同运行中，我们观察到参数的微小相对变化（0.025-0.098%）以及学生模型在OPD前后表示之间的高度相似性（线性CKA > 0.98跨层）。这些观察结果表明，有限的表示适应可能导致了学习信号崩溃，这一假设仍有待验证。代码可在https://github.com/leizhao7/opd-learning-signals获取。

articles.title: Read What Matters: Query-Adaptive Quantization for KV Caches
articles.abstract: KV-cache entries are stored before their future queries are known, but each decoding query needs precision in different places. We study this mismatch using separate budgets for retained bits and bits fetched per query. ReadKV stores each key and value in a progressive code whose prefixes support different reconstruction precisions. For each query, it allocates key-channel prefixes using the query, computes attention from the reconstructed keys, and then allocates value-token prefixes using that attention. Stored entries remain unchanged. Each stage optimizes a calibrated distortion objective under a fixed budget; we prove exact allocation under diminishing refinement gains and relate these objectives to attention-output error. We also exhibit a finite-dimensional attention family where query-dependent access strictly outperforms every query-independent reader at the same read budget, even with unrestricted competing encoders and decoders. Across six base models, reading four bits on average from an eight-bit cache increases C4 perplexity by at most 0.66%, using about one quarter of the logical reads and half the retained capacity of a 16-bit cache. It is consistently more accurate than storing and fully reading four bits at the same payload-read budget. Retaining more bits than each query fetches is aimed at long-context decoding, where the cache bytes moved per step, rather than the weights, dominate cost. Long-context question answering and retrieval on two instruction-tuned models provide additional quality evidence. On the tested 8K-token, batch-one, single-layer workload on an NVIDIA A10G, a restricted eight-bit ReadKV reader with a two-bit mean payload-read budget has 39% lower latency than the tested TurboQuant codec.
articles.titleCn: 阅读《何为重要：适用于KV缓存的查询自适应量化》
articles.abstractCn: KV缓存条目在它们未来的查询未知的情况下被存储，但每个解码查询需要在不同的位置保持精确性。我们使用保留比特和每查询获取比特的独立预算来研究这种不匹配。ReadKV将每个键和值存储在一个渐进式编码中，其前缀支持不同的重建精度。对于每个查询，它使用查询分配键信道前缀，从重建的键中计算注意力，然后使用该注意力分配值标记前缀。存储的条目保持不变。每个阶段在固定预算下优化校准的失真目标；我们证明了在递减的精炼收益下精确分配，并将这些目标与注意力输出误差相关联。我们还展示了一个有限维度的注意力家族，其中查询相关的访问在相同的读取预算下严格优于所有查询无关的读取器，即使存在无限制的竞争编码器和解码器。在六个基础模型中，从八位缓存中平均读取四位，将C4困惑度最多提高0.66%，使用大约四分之一的逻辑读取和一半的保留容量，相当于16位缓存的一半。在相同的有效读取预算下，它始终比存储并完全读取四位更准确。保留比每个查询获取更多的比特旨在用于长上下文解码，其中每步移动的缓存字节，而不是权重，主导成本。长上下文问答和指令调优模型上的检索提供了额外的质量证据。在NVIDIA A10G上的8K标记、批处理一、单层工作负载测试中，具有两位平均有效读取预算的受限八位ReadKV读取器比测试的TurboQuant编解码器延迟低39%。

articles.title: MiniVer-V: Identifying Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Short Video Verification
articles.abstract: A core challenge in short-video fact-checking is identifying which evidence is sufficient to support a verification conclusion. Existing approaches either give the verifier all available evidence, introducing noise, or select evidence by topical relevance, which conflates relatedness with sufficiency. We identify evidential sufficiency as the selection criterion: whether a subset of evidence is adequate to support a confident verdict without redundancy. We introduce MiniVer-V, a benchmark of 195 short videos with three-way verdict annotations (supported, refuted, insufficient) and 5,510 multimodal evidence units spanning visual keyframes, speech transcripts, and web-retrieved external sources. We propose a two-layer verification framework that separates claim-video consistency, assessed from internal evidence, from factual verdict determination, which additionally requires external corroboration. On top of it, a sufficiency-driven greedy search assembles evidence until a sufficiency threshold is met and outputs insufficient when the candidate pool is exhausted, rather than forcing a verdict. With Claude Sonnet 4, the method reaches a Macro-F1 of 0.510 using 4.5 evidence units on average (16% of the full evidence set), statistically indistinguishable from the full-evidence baseline (0.518 with 27.7 units), while significantly improving recognition of insufficient cases over the same search without abstention. The efficiency result replicates with GPT-5.5 and holds only partially with an open-weight Qwen2.5-72B verifier. Ablations show that external evidence is indispensable for factual determination, while internal video evidence grounds the verdict in claim-video consistency. These findings suggest that evidence-efficient verification is achievable, and that explicit abstention is needed when evidence is genuinely inadequate.
articles.titleCn: MiniVer-V：识别短视频验证的最小充分证据
articles.abstractCn: 短视频事实核查中的一个核心挑战是识别哪些证据足以支持核查结论。现有方法要么向核查者提供所有可用证据，从而引入噪声，要么根据主题相关性选择证据，这混淆了关联性与充分性。我们确定证据充分性为选择标准：即一个证据子集是否足以在无冗余的情况下支持一个有信心的裁决。我们引入了MiniVer-V，这是一个包含195个短视频的基准，具有三项裁决标注（支持、反驳、不足）和5,510个跨模态证据单元，涵盖视觉关键帧、语音文本和网页检索的外部来源。我们提出了一种双层核查框架，将声明-视频一致性（通过内部证据评估）与事实裁决确定（额外需要外部佐证）分离开来。在此基础上，我们采用了一种以充分性驱动的贪婪搜索，直到达到充分性阈值为止收集证据，并在候选池耗尽时输出不足，而不是强制做出裁决。使用Claude Sonnet 4，该方法平均使用4.5个证据单元（占完整证据集的16%）达到Macro-F1 0.510，与完整证据基线（使用27.7个单元，Macro-F1为0.518）在统计上无显著差异，同时在相同搜索过程中显著提高了对不足案例的识别率。效率结果在GPT-5.5上得到验证，但在开放权重的Qwen2.5-72B核查者上仅部分成立。消融实验表明，外部证据对于事实确定是不可缺少的，而内部视频证据则基于声明-视频一致性来支撑裁决。这些发现表明，证据高效的核查是可行的，当证据确实不足时，需要明确地放弃裁决。

articles.title: SafeInferCom: Safe Inference-Time Compute via Verifier-Guided Mid-Generation Intervention for Robotic Task Planning
articles.abstract: Large Reasoning Language Models (LRLMs) enable multi-step reasoning for robotic task planning, but continued reasoning can overwrite valid intermediate plans or leave constraint violations unresolved, reducing planning reliability and wasting inference-time computation. We develop an inference-time monitor that exposes and verifies intermediate plans without disrupting the original decoding trajectory. Building on this monitor, we propose SafeInferCom, a formal verifier-guided framework that preserves valid intermediate plans and directs error correction during generation. Experiments across multiple LRLMs and planning domains reveal reasoning-response inconsistency and limited self-correction under one-shot inference. SafeInferCom improves planning success and accelerates error correction relative to one-shot inference. When combined with iterative refinement, it further improves success while reducing token usage compared with refinement alone. We additionally evaluate SafeInferCom in VirtualHome and provide a real-world robotic-arm demonstration.
articles.titleCn: SafeInferCom：基于验证者引导的中间生成干预，为机器人任务规划实现安全推理时计算
articles.abstractCn: 大型推理语言模型（LRLMs）能够为机器人任务规划实现多步推理，但持续的推理可能会覆盖有效的中间计划或留下未解决的约束违规问题，从而降低规划可靠性并浪费推理时间计算。我们开发了一个推理时监控器，能够在不中断原始解码轨迹的情况下暴露和验证中间计划。基于该监控器，我们提出了SafeInferCom，这是一个由形式化验证器指导的框架，能够保留有效的中间计划并在生成过程中引导错误纠正。跨多个LRLMs和规划领域的实验揭示了单次推理下推理响应不一致和自我纠正能力有限的问题。与单次推理相比，SafeInferCom提高了规划成功率并加速了错误纠正。当与迭代优化结合使用时，它相较于单独优化进一步提高了成功率，同时减少了token使用量。此外，我们在VirtualHome中评估了SafeInferCom，并提供了一个真实的机械臂演示。

articles.title: The Lattice of Transition Laws
articles.abstract: Diffusion and autoregression (AR) have long been seen as different categories of generative models, with diffusion specialising in continuous fields and AR specialising in discrete tokens. Recent work seeks to combine the advantages of the two models, and each hybrid fixes its decoding schedule by design. In this paper, we ask whether the performance of decoding schedules of one model can be predicted before decoding at a fixed number of steps. We describe diffusion, AR, and models in between as paths on one corruption lattice, and define the cost of a schedule as the dependence its parallel steps discard. The cost shows that the fewest steps of a zero-cost schedule are set by the geometry of the data, in the same way for tokens and for continuous fields. In particular, for data that are Markov on a graph and dependent along its paths, the fewest steps equal the graph's treedepth, which is logarithmic in the length of a sequence and linear in the side length of a grid. With fewer steps than the treedepth, every schedule pays a positive cost, whose ranking we predict before decoding with a kernel of pairwise dependence estimated from pretrained weights. Across text generation, image generation, and video generation, we verify most of the predictions about the rankings of different schedules under different metrics and benchmarks. This work therefore provides a design principle for decoding for future AR models, diffusion models, and anything in between. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/The-Lattice-of-Transition-Laws.
articles.titleCn: 转换律格
articles.abstractCn: 扩散模型和自回归（AR）模型长期以来被视为生成模型的两种不同类别，其中扩散模型专注于连续场，而AR模型专注于离散标记。近期的研究试图结合两种模型的优势，并且每种混合模型都通过设计来固定其解码调度。在本文中，我们探讨了是否可以在固定步数解码之前预测一种模型解码调度的性能。我们将扩散模型、AR模型以及介于两者之间的模型描述为同一破坏格上的路径，并将调度的成本定义为其并行步骤所丢弃的依赖关系。成本表明，零成本调度的最少数步骤由数据的几何结构决定，对于标记和连续场都是如此。特别是，对于在图上具有马尔可夫性质且沿其路径依赖的数据，最少数步骤等于图的树深度，该深度在序列长度上是 logarithmic 的，在网格边长上是 linear 的。少于树深度的步骤，每种调度都会支付正成本，我们通过从预训练权重中估计的成对依赖核在解码前预测其排名。在文本生成、图像生成和视频生成中，我们验证了关于不同指标和基准下不同调度排名的大多数预测。因此，这项工作为未来AR模型、扩散模型以及介于两者之间的任何模型提供了解码的设计原则。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/The-Lattice-of-Transition-Laws 获取。

articles.title: Bridging KV-Cache Quantization and Linear Attention: From Theory to Pretrained Weight Migration
articles.abstract: KV-cache quantization and linear attention are two representative approaches to tackling the storage and computational costs of Transformers. KV-cache quantization compresses individual KV entries into discrete codes but retains all entries, whereas linear attention recurrently aggregates multiple historical KV contributions into a fixed-size continuous state but can introduce interference. This contrast raises the question of whether per-KV compression and multi-KV aggregation can be bridged within a single mechanism for efficient attention. We identify RAM-Net as such a bridge through soft assignments over a discrete address space. These assignments determine recurrent updates to the continuous slot state associated with each address. Under a restricted RAM-Net construction, we prove that soft address assignments extend hard quantized matching to a separable read-write overlap that locally approximates full-attention similarity and supports recurrent aggregation. These connections further enable Transformer-to-RAM-Net weight migration through a new path based on a soft-quantized intermediate construction. Across nine pretrained Transformer models from 0.3B to 7B parameters, RAM-Net recovers an average of 87.1% of the teachers' accuracy gains over random guessing across six commonsense and knowledge tasks using only a 500M-token budget per model.
articles.titleCn: 连接KV缓存量化和线性注意力：从理论到预训练权重迁移
articles.abstractCn: KV缓存量化和线性注意力是解决Transformer存储和计算成本的两个代表性方法。KV缓存量化将单个KV条目压缩成离散码，但保留所有条目，而线性注意力则反复将多个历史KV贡献聚合为固定大小的连续状态，但可能引入干扰。这种对比引发了这样的问题：是否能在单一机制中结合每KV压缩和多KV聚合来实现高效的注意力？我们通过在离散地址空间上进行软分配，将RAM-Net识别为这样的桥梁。这些分配决定了与每个地址相关联的连续槽状态的循环更新。在受限的RAM-Net结构下，我们证明了软地址分配将硬量化匹配扩展为可分离的读写重叠，该重叠局部近似全注意力相似性并支持循环聚合。这些联系进一步通过基于软量化中间结构的全新路径，实现了Transformer到RAM-Net的权重迁移。在九个从0.3B到7B参数的预训练Transformer模型中，RAM-Net仅使用每个模型500M-token的预算，在六个常识和知识任务上平均恢复了87.1%的教师相对于随机猜测的准确率提升。

articles.title: Selective Listening: Mechanism-Guided Control of Audio Influence in Large Audio-Language Models
articles.abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) exploit multimodal evidence, yet task-irrelevant audio can alter text-reasoning decisions when listening is unnecessary. Aggregate Accuracy can hide this paired drift because audio-induced repairs and damages may cancel. Paired drift analysis and targeted interventions identify architecture-specific, intervention-sensitive late audio pathways as actionable control points. We introduce ICAP-Gate, which applies mechanism-guided, task-conditioned control to each model's pathway. Across four LALMs, two reasoning benchmarks, and environmental-sound and natural-speech interference, ICAP-Gate has lower point estimates for Influence Rate and Answer Flip than ungated inference in all 16 full-split model--condition evaluations. Fixed suppression degrades automatic speech recognition (ASR) across all four models, whereas ICAP-Gate matches ungated ASR performance by preserving the pathway for explicit audio-demand instructions. ICAP-Gate has lower paired-drift point estimates than mitigation prompting in all four evaluated settings and provides competitive stabilization relative to eight-sample Self-Consistency while using one generation per query; in controlled ARC measurements, Self-Consistency incurs $7.0$--$9.2\times$ ungated latency. These results establish selective modality influence control as a design principle for robust multimodal reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 选择性聆听：大型音频语言模型中音频影响的机制引导控制
articles.abstractCn: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）利用多模态证据，但在无需听音的情况下，任务无关的音频仍可能改变文本推理决策。聚合准确率可能掩盖这种配对漂移，因为音频引起的修复和损坏可能会相互抵消。配对漂移分析和针对性干预可识别出特定于架构、对干预敏感的晚期音频通路，将其作为可操作的控点。我们引入了ICAP-Gate，该机制对每个模型的通路应用机制引导、任务条件化的控制。在四个LALMs、两个推理基准以及环境声音和自然语音干扰下，ICAP-Gate在所有16个完整分割模型—条件评估中，对影响率和答案翻转的点估计均低于未加门控的推理。固定抑制会降低所有四个模型的自动语音识别（ASR）性能，而ICAP-Gate通过保留用于明确音频指令的通路，使性能与未加门控的ASR相当。在所有四个评估场景中，ICAP-Gate的配对漂移点估计均低于缓解提示，同时在使用每条查询生成一次的情况下，其稳定性与八样本Self-Consistency具有竞争力；在受控的ARC测量中，Self-Consistency导致的延迟是无门控延迟的7.0至9.2倍。这些结果确立了选择性模态影响控制作为鲁棒多模态推理设计原则的地位。

articles.title: RAG-Stress: Probing the Limits of Evidence Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Following retrieved evidence does not guarantee factual correctness: misleading evidence can induce a model to replace an answer it previously gave correctly. Standard accuracy measures obscure this behavior by combining answer replacement with preexisting errors. We introduce RAG-Stress, a controlled diagnostic protocol for examining the limits of evidence reliance in retrieval-augmented generation. The protocol holds the question and reference answer fixed, edits one assertion to support a designated incorrect answer, and crosses two source priority policies with three positions of the answer span within the evidence text. We measure misleading rate (MR) on each model's subset of questions answered correctly without retrieval, alongside clean accuracy on the full evaluation set. We evaluate fifteen systems spanning API models, open models, and search agents trained with reinforcement learning on TriviaQA-RC, HotpotQA, and SearchQA, with additional English and Chinese MedQA evaluations. Instructions that prioritize documents consistently produce higher MR than those permitting reliance on prior knowledge. Averaged over models and positions, the gap ranges from 10.9 to 13.5 percentage points across the three QA datasets. Mean MR follows End $>$ Beginning $>$ Middle under both policies, although individual models do not uniformly follow this ordering. A separate paired audit of 500 questions and two checkpoints supports increased harmful override without establishing a corresponding improvement in beneficial correction. These findings distinguish evidence adherence from factual reliability and motivate evaluating whether retrieved evidence preserves, replaces, or corrects a model's answers.
articles.titleCn: RAG-Stress：探究检索增强生成中证据依赖的极限
articles.abstractCn: 所检索的证据并不能保证事实准确性：误导性证据可能使模型替换其先前正确给出的答案。标准准确度指标通过将答案替换与现有错误结合在一起，掩盖了这种行为。我们引入了RAG-Stress，这是一种用于检查检索增强生成中证据依赖极限的控制诊断协议。该协议将问题和参考答案固定，编辑一个支持指定错误答案的断言，并在证据文本中交叉两种来源优先策略和三种答案跨度位置。我们在每个模型正确回答无需检索的问题子集上测量误导率（MR），同时在完整评估集上测量清洁准确度。我们在TriviaQA-RC、HotpotQA和SearchQA上评估了十五个系统，涵盖API模型、开源模型以及使用强化学习训练的搜索代理，并进行了额外的英语和中文MedQA评估。优先考虑文档的指令产生的MR高于允许依赖先验知识的指令。在三个QA数据集上，平均跨模型和位置，差距在10.9到13.5个百分点之间。在两种策略下，平均MR遵循末尾 $>$ 开头 $>$ 中间的顺序，尽管单个模型并不都遵循这种顺序。对500个问题和两个检查点的单独配对审计支持了有害覆盖的增加，但没有建立相应的有益纠正改进。这些发现区分了证据依从性与事实可靠性，并促使评估检索证据是保存、替换还是纠正了模型的答案。

articles.title: LadderEdit: Edit-Level Residual Compression for Memory-Efficient Lifelong Editing of LLMs
articles.abstract: Lifelong editing of LLMs requires storing thousands of edits after acquisition. A widely used family of approaches attaches one LoRA adapter per edit, which preserves behavior but grows linearly in storage. To address this challenge, we propose LadderEdit, a method that compresses each LoRA adapter after it is acquired. Each edit is first stored at low rank as a cheap sketch. We then check whether this sketch still satisfies the rewrite, generalization, and locality contract on probe prompts. Edits that pass keep the sketch; those that fail are promoted to a higher rank along a ladder until the contract is met. Because every edit retains some representation, coverage is maintained, and only hard edits consume more rank. Across ZsRE, CounterFact, and WikiBigEdit benchmarks on LLaMA-3-8B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-7B, LadderEdit tracks exact LoRA storage at 5.2x less memory and remains effective at 50,000 sequential edits.
articles.titleCn: LadderEdit：编辑级别的残差压缩，用于内存高效的LLM终身编辑
articles.abstractCn: 对大型语言模型进行终身编辑需要存储数千次编辑记录。一种广泛使用的方法是为每次编辑附加一个LoRA适配器，这可以保留模型行为但导致存储量线性增长。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了LadderEdit方法，该方法在LoRA适配器获取后会对其进行压缩。每次编辑首先以低秩形式存储为一个廉价的草图。然后我们检查该草图是否仍然满足在测试提示上的重写、泛化和局部性合同。通过测试的编辑保留草图；未通过的编辑则沿着一个梯子提升到更高秩，直到合同得到满足。由于每次编辑都保留了一定的表示，因此覆盖率得以维持，只有硬编辑会消耗更多秩。在ZsRE、CounterFact和WikiBigEdit基准测试中，针对LLaMA-3-8B、Mistral-7B和Qwen2.5-7B模型，LadderEdit在5.2倍的内存减少下追踪了精确的LoRA存储，并在50,000次连续编辑中保持有效。

articles.title: Local Prototype Reconstruction for Text-Compatible Speech-to-LLM Bridge Pretraining
articles.abstract: Speech-to-LLM systems often connect a frozen speech encoder to a frozen large language model (LLM) through a small trainable bridge. The bridge is usually treated as plumbing, but it in fact defines the geometry of the speech-to-LLM interface, and the pretraining objective decides whether that interface provides a reusable initialization for downstream tasks. We study a transferable bridge through two complementary properties: global alignment with the text side, and local lexical manifold compatibility, where bridge embeddings remain close to the frozen LLM's input-embedding neighbourhoods. We make this property measurable with a fixed, head-free, timestamp-free diagnostic that applies to any objective, and show that next-word prediction (NWP) and sentence-level contrastive pretraining do not fully capture token-level lexical compatibility. We then introduce Local Prototype Reconstruction (LPR), a lightweight training-only regularizer that requires each aligned bridge token to be reconstructable from a small neighbourhood of frozen LLM token embeddings, with a hard single-prototype anchor as its limiting case. On multilingual ASR and speech translation, LPR improves transfer, with the largest gains on translation and low-resource adaptation. Crucially, our independent diagnostic correlates with downstream gains across objectives, suggesting that lexical manifold compatibility is predictive of reusability for speech-to-LLM bridges.
articles.titleCn: 文本兼容语音到LLM桥接预训练的本地原型重建
articles.abstractCn: 语音到大型语言模型（LLM）系统通常通过一个小型可训练桥接器将冻结的语音编码器连接到冻结的大型语言模型。这个桥接器通常被视为管道，但实际上定义了语音到LLM接口的几何结构，而预训练目标决定了该接口是否为下游任务提供可重用的初始化。我们通过两个互补特性研究可迁移的桥接器：与文本侧的全局对齐，以及局部词汇流形兼容性，其中桥接器嵌入保持接近冻结LLM的输入嵌入邻域。我们通过一个固定、无头、无时间戳的诊断方法使这一特性可衡量，该方法适用于任何目标，并表明词预测（NWP）和句子级对比预训练并未完全捕捉到词级词汇兼容性。随后，我们引入局部原型重建（LPR），这是一种轻量级的仅用于训练的正则化器，它要求每个对齐的桥接器词能够从冻结LLM词嵌入的小邻域中重建，其极端情况是硬单原型锚点。在多语言语音识别和语音翻译任务上，LPR提升了迁移性能，其中翻译和低资源适应获得了最大增益。关键在于，我们的独立诊断与跨目标的下游增益相关，表明词汇流形兼容性是语音到LLM桥接器可重用性的预测指标。

articles.title: Do LLMs Learn from Rewards in Context? : Rethinking the role of reward in In-Context Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: LLM agents increasingly improve at inference time by accumulating experience in context rather than by updating parameters. This process is often described as in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL). Whether in-context learning (ICL) can actually play the role of RL, however, has not been tested. We study this question in its simplest form, direct ICRL, where the model conditions directly on raw trajectory-reward pairs, and ask whether the reward acts as a learning signal. Through controlled experiments on four benchmarks across six models, we find that the reward is read, but its effect is small: flipping, randomizing, or removing the reward leaves the improvement curve almost unchanged, and this holds even under meta-prompts that explicitly instruct the model to explore, exploit, or reason over rewards. Trajectories drive improvement, but not through their semantic content: shuffled or corrupted trajectories work as well as real ones. These patterns closely mirror those known in ICL, suggesting that direct ICRL is better understood as a special case of ICL than as inference-time RL. This reframing has implications for agent memory design: ICL factors such as input distribution and demonstrations may matter more than RL elements such as reward shaping and exploration.
articles.titleCn: LLMs 在情境中是否从奖励中学习？：重新思考奖励在情境强化学习中的作用
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理通过在上下文中积累经验，而非更新参数，在推理时不断改进。这一过程通常被描述为上下文强化学习（ICRL）。然而，上下文学习（ICL）是否真的能发挥强化学习的作用，尚未得到验证。我们以最简单直接的形式研究这个问题——直接ICRL，其中模型直接基于原始轨迹-奖励对进行条件化，并探究奖励是否充当学习信号。通过对六个模型在四个基准测试上的受控实验，我们发现奖励确实被读取，但其影响很小：翻转、随机化或移除奖励都不会改变改进曲线，即使在明确指示模型探索、利用或推理奖励的元提示下也是如此。轨迹驱动改进，但并非通过其语义内容：打乱或损坏的轨迹效果与真实轨迹相当。这些模式与ICL中已知的模式高度相似，表明直接ICRL最好被理解为ICL的一种特殊情况，而非推理时的强化学习。这种重新定位对代理记忆设计具有启示意义：上下文学习因素（如输入分布和示例）可能比强化学习元素（如奖励塑形和探索）更重要。

articles.title: ActiveMedAgent: Cost-Aware Trajectory Learning for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis
articles.abstract: Clinical diagnosis is inherently sequential: clinicians escalate from cheap to costly tests only when additional evidence is expected to resolve diagnostic uncertainty. We present ActiveMedAgent, a framework that brings this cost-aware sequential logic to multimodal medical AI. Given a frozen, API-accessed vision-language model, ActiveMedAgent tracks probability distributions over candidate diagnoses and scores each acquisition by its per-step diagnostic utility minus cost. A lightweight MLP controller is then trained offline on these scored trajectories, learning when to request additional evidence and when to commit. Across three commonly used benchmarks, trajectory-based policy learning consistently outperforms both unguided acquisition and full-modality baselines. Notably, we identify an information overload effect. In 175 cases, the agent produces a correct diagnosis with fewer channels while the full-modality baseline fails, showing that learning what to omit can be as important as learning what to acquire.
articles.titleCn: ActiveMedAgent：面向多模态医学诊断的成本感知轨迹学习
articles.abstractCn: 临床诊断本质上具有顺序性：临床医生只有在预期额外证据能够解决诊断不确定性时，才会从廉价测试升级到昂贵测试。我们提出了ActiveMedAgent框架，将这种成本感知的顺序逻辑引入多模态医疗AI。给定一个冻结的、可通过API访问的视觉语言模型，ActiveMedAgent跟踪候选诊断的概率分布，并根据每一步的诊断效用减去成本来评分每次获取。然后，在基于这些评分轨迹上离线训练一个轻量级MLP控制器，学习何时请求额外证据以及何时做出决策。在三个常用的基准测试中，基于轨迹的策略学习始终优于无引导获取和全模态基线。值得注意的是，我们识别出了一种信息过载效应。在175个案例中，代理使用更少的通道做出了正确诊断，而全模态基线却失败了，这表明学习该忽略什么与学习该获取什么同样重要。

articles.title: The "10th Juror": Open-Set Standpoint Screening for Bureaucratic Bias Detection
articles.abstract: Presupposing the boundaries of bias is itself a form of bias. We study closed-loop bias governance for Dutch government documents, where a system must detect biased language, ground decisions in legal and contextual evidence, rewrite problematic sentences when intervention is warranted, and verify that the rewrite mitigates harm without distorting meaning. Existing methods face three challenges: (i) discriminative classifiers capture surface regularities but lack normative grounding; (ii) zero-shot LLMs often adopt generic viewpoints and over-flag ambiguous administrative language; and (iii) fixed taxonomies inherit the Closed-World Assumption, missing emerging local targets. We propose MARS-Gov, a standpoint-aware multi-agent framework that combines legal retrieval, open-set target screening, specialized jurors, conservative routing, and rewrite verification. When screening finds an uncovered group, MARS-Gov instantiates a dynamic "10th juror" to deliberate outside the fixed panel. On DGDB, MARS-Gov sets a new SOTA with 0.880 F1, outperforming the strongest zero-shot LLM detector by 20.2 points (29.8% relative) and the best supervised Dutch encoder by 6.8 points, while reducing unnecessary interventions to 2.5%. Leave-One-Category-Out (LOCO) evaluation recovers held-out categories with 85.1% Correct@1 and 93.8% Correct@3.
articles.titleCn: 《第十陪审员》：官僚主义偏见检测的开放集立场筛选
articles.abstractCn: 预设偏见边界本身就是一种偏见。我们研究荷兰政府文件中的闭环偏见治理，其中系统必须检测偏见性语言，以法律和上下文证据为基础做出决策，在必要时重写有问题的句子，并验证重写能够减轻危害而不扭曲原意。现有方法面临三个挑战：(i) 判别分类器捕捉表面规律但缺乏规范性基础；(ii) 零样本大语言模型常采用通用观点且过度标记模糊的行政语言；(iii) 固定分类体系继承封闭世界假设，遗漏新兴本地目标。我们提出了MARS-Gov，一个立场感知的多智能体框架，结合法律检索、开放集目标筛选、专业陪审团、保守路由和重写验证。当筛选发现未覆盖群体时，MARS-Gov会实例化动态的"第十位陪审员"在固定陪审团外进行商议。在DGDB上，MARS-Gov以0.880 F1的成绩创下新SOTA，比最强的零样本大语言模型检测器领先20.2分（相对提升29.8%），比最佳监督式荷兰语编码器领先6.8分，同时将不必要的干预减少至2.5%。Leave-One-Category-Out（LOCO）评估以85.1%的Correct@1和93.8%的Correct@3恢复了保留类别的目标。

articles.title: Can a System-One LLM Perform Knowledge Tracing When Few or No Learners Are Logged?
articles.abstract: Knowledge tracing (KT) models need many logged learners, so a new course or platform starts without a usable model. In LLM-based KT the LLM generates the answer, which we call System-Two; it is either fine-tuned on the target data or reasons and votes over ten samples, which is slow and gives coarse probabilities. We ask whether an off-the-shelf System-One LLM, which returns a probability for a typed question directly in a single pass, can perform KT when few or no learners are logged. On seven datasets, Jev without any data from the target platform reaches a mean AUC of .706, above the best of 28 deep KT models trained on 8 learners (.689) and above System-Two Thinking-KT on all seven datasets (.650) at about 1/100 of its API cost. Adding examples and a similar-learner statistic from the logged learners (JevKT) raises this to .722; JevKT stays significantly ahead of deep KT up to 16 learners and ahead on average up to 64, and supervised KT catches up between 64 and 128 learners. Among the readers we tested, the gain is specific to Jev, since three other LLMs queried with the byte-identical typed request through the official System-One adapter fall below it on all seven datasets, and reader swaps and contamination checks find no evidence that the input format or memorised data explain the gain. For new learners the advantage holds from their first interactions, whereas on unseen items with all learners logged, deep KT remains ahead.
articles.comment: 41 pages, 7 figures. Code and result summaries: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/jevkt-coldstart
articles.titleCn: 一个系统一的大型语言模型能在几乎没有或没有学习者登录时进行知识追踪吗？
articles.abstractCn: 知识追踪（KT）模型需要大量已记录的学习者数据，因此新课程或平台在开始时无法使用有效的模型。在基于大型语言模型（LLM）的KT中，LLM生成答案，我们称之为系统二；它要么在目标数据上进行微调，要么对十个样本进行推理和投票，这很慢且给出粗糙的概率。我们提出的问题是：一个现成的系统一LLM，它直接在一次遍历中对定型问题返回概率，在很少或没有学习者记录的情况下能否执行KT。在七个数据集上，没有任何目标平台数据的Jev达到了平均AUC为0.706，高于在8个学习者上训练的28个深度KT模型的最佳表现（0.689），并且在所有七个数据集上高于系统二的Thinking-KT（0.650），其API成本约为1/100。添加示例和从已记录学习者中提取的相似学习者统计量（JevKT）将其提高到0.722；JevKT在16个学习者之前始终显著领先于深度KT，并且在64个学习者之前平均领先，而监督KT在64到128个学习者之间赶上。在我们测试的读者中，这种提升是针对Jev的，因为其他三个LLM通过官方系统一适配器以字节完全相同的定型请求进行查询，在所有七个数据集上都低于Jev，读者交换和污染检查没有发现任何证据表明输入格式或记忆数据可以解释这种提升。对于新学习者，这种优势从他们第一次交互时就开始显现，而在所有学习者已记录的未见过的问题上，深度KT仍然领先。

articles.title: SFT-as-Context Mitigates Forgetting in Supervised Fine-Tuning
articles.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) equips large language models (LLMs) with specialized capabilities, but often comes at the cost of forgetting the general capabilities of their parent models (i.e., the pretrained models before fine-tuning). This trade-off is especially limiting for queries that require both specialized and general capabilities. We introduce SFT-as-context, a training-free method in which the parent model uses the SFT model's response as context to answer the query. This allows the parent model to acquire fine-tuned capabilities from the SFT response through in-context learning while preserving its own general capabilities. Across 19 parent-SFT model pairs and 11 benchmarks, SFT-as-context remains close to the SFT models on fine-tuned capabilities, with gaps of only 2.2 and 2.1 percentage points on AIME 2024 and LiveCodeBench and 2.0 macro MAE on NutriBench-English, while staying within 2.2 percentage points of the parent models on general capabilities on average. Remarkably, it can solve queries requiring both fine-tuned and general capabilities, even when neither the parent nor SFT model succeeds alone. This approach also extends beyond parent-SFT pairs: responses from a small open-source SFT model can improve a strong closed-source LLM, outperforming either model alone. Furthermore, we use a Bayesian framework to derive theoretical guarantees that bound the error of SFT-as-context relative to the SFT model on fine-tuned capabilities and to the parent model on general capabilities. In addition, we visualize the attention weights and find that the parent model attends more to useful SFT responses and less to irrelevant ones, suggesting that selective attention helps the parent model use the SFT response through in-context learning.
articles.titleCn: SFT-as-Context 方法减轻了监督微调中的遗忘问题
articles.abstractCn: 监督微调（SFT）为大型语言模型（LLM）赋予专业能力，但往往以牺牲其父模型（即微调前的预训练模型）的通用能力为代价。这种权衡对于需要专业和通用能力兼备的查询尤其具有局限性。我们引入了SFT-as-context，这是一种无需训练的方法，其中父模型利用SFT模型的响应作为上下文来回答查询。这允许父模型通过情境学习从SFT响应中获取微调能力，同时保留其自身的通用能力。在19对父模型-SFT模型和11个基准测试中，SFT-as-context在微调能力上与SFT模型保持接近，在AIME 2024和LiveCodeBench上的差距仅为2.2和2.1个百分点，在NutriBench-English上的宏观MAE为2.0，同时在平均情况下，其通用能力与父模型的差距保持在2.2个百分点以内。值得注意的是，即使父模型和SFT模型单独都无法成功，它也能解决需要专业和通用能力的查询。这种方法还超越了父模型-SFT对的范围：一个小型开源SFT模型的响应可以提升一个强大的闭源LLM，其表现优于单独的任一模型。此外，我们使用贝叶斯框架推导出理论保证，这些保证界定了SFT-as-context相对于SFT模型在微调能力上的误差，以及相对于父模型在通用能力上的误差。此外，我们还可视化了注意力权重，发现父模型更关注有用的SFT响应，而较少关注无关的响应，这表明选择性注意力有助于父模型通过情境学习利用SFT响应。

articles.title: GameCommBench: A Unified Benchmark and Type-Aware Evaluation for AI-Generated Game Commentary
articles.abstract: Game commentary is an open-ended generation task requiring multimodal perception, strategic reasoning, and contextual knowledge. Existing AI-Generated Game Commentary (AI-GGC) studies remain fragmented across games, modalities, and evaluation protocols, while overlap-based or holistic evaluators fail to capture the functional heterogeneity of commentary. We introduce \textsc{GameCommBench}, a unified benchmark spanning board games, sports, and esports, with commentary aligned to heterogeneous game contexts and annotated by commentary type. We further propose Type-Aware Commentary Evaluation (TACE), a structured framework for evaluating different types of commentary. We then validate TACE for reliability and human agreement, and use it to benchmark representative AI commentators. Results reveal non-uniform capability profiles, with live observation and strategic analysis emerging as major bottlenecks. Together, \textsc{GameCommBench} and TACE provide a diagnostic foundation for comparable and interpretable AI-GGC evaluation.
articles.titleCn: GameCommBench：一个统一基准和类型感知评估方法，用于AI生成的游戏解说
articles.abstractCn: 游戏解说是一项开放式生成任务，需要多模态感知、策略推理和上下文知识。现有的AI生成游戏解说（AI-GGC）研究仍然分散于不同游戏、模态和评估协议，而基于重叠或整体评估的评估器未能捕捉解说的功能异质性。我们引入了\textsc{GameCommBench}，这是一个涵盖棋盘游戏、体育和电子竞技的统一基准，解说内容与异构游戏环境相匹配，并按解说类型进行标注。我们进一步提出了类型感知解说评估（TACE），这是一个用于评估不同类型解说的结构化框架。然后我们验证了TACE的可靠性和人类一致性，并使用它来对代表性的AI解说员进行基准测试。结果表明，能力分布不均，实时观察和策略分析成为主要瓶颈。综合来看，\textsc{GameCommBench}和TACE为可比且可解释的AI-GGC评估提供了诊断基础。

articles.title: Lapras: Latent Reasoning for Time Series Language Models
articles.abstract: Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) offer a promising path toward time series understanding by reasoning over temporal signals and producing natural language answers and explanations. A common approach is Chain-of-Thought (CoT), which generates step-by-step rationales linking relevant signal patterns to final answers. Although these models learn from reference CoT traces during post-training, generating faithful descriptions of input time series at inference remains challenging. Expressing high-dimensional, continuous temporal representations in discrete language tokens may cause the model to neglect task-relevant patterns or describe them inaccurately. Because later reasoning steps build on these descriptions, early errors propagate, leading to incorrect answers with plausible explanations that are inconsistent with the input signal. We propose Lapras (Latent Post-trained Reasoning Across Series), a post-training framework that equips TSLMs with latent reasoning. A model trained with Lapras reasons through a sequence of continuous thoughts in the joint time series-language space, producing text only for the final answer. It learns this through teacher-student self-distillation, where a teacher trained on CoT reference traces reasons explicitly through text. The student aligns its hidden states with the teacher's at the answer stage, transferring the teacher's reasoning ability into its latent computation. We evaluate Lapras across four TSLM backbones on five time series question answering benchmarks. Lapras improves average F1 by up to 10.79% over explicit CoT while generating 23.9x fewer tokens. Lapras's continuous thoughts can also be decoded into readable reasoning traces via standard language decoding, preserving textual explanations. Together, these results highlight Lapras as a promising post-training paradigm for efficient, effective, and interpretable TSLM reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 拉普拉斯：时间序列语言模型的潜在推理
articles.abstractCn: 时间序列语言模型（TSLMs）通过推理时间信号并生成自然语言答案和解释，为时间序列理解提供了有前景的途径。一种常见的方法是思维链（CoT），它生成逐步的推理过程，将相关信号模式与最终答案联系起来。尽管这些模型在训练后从参考CoT轨迹中学习，但在推理时生成输入时间序列的忠实描述仍然具有挑战性。将高维、连续的时间表示表达为离散的语言标记可能会导致模型忽略与任务相关的模式或对其进行不准确描述。由于后续的推理步骤依赖于这些描述，早期的错误会传播，导致生成看似合理的解释，但与输入信号不一致的错误答案。我们提出了Lapras（系列间潜在训练后推理），这是一个训练后框架，为TSLMs配备了潜在推理能力。使用Lapras训练的模型在联合时间序列-语言空间中通过一系列连续的思考进行推理，仅在最终答案阶段生成文本。它通过教师-学生自我蒸馏学习这种能力，其中在CoT参考轨迹上训练的教师通过文本进行显式推理。学生将其隐藏状态与教师在答案阶段的隐藏状态对齐，将教师的推理能力转移到其潜在计算中。我们在四个TSLM主干模型上对五个时间序列问答基准评估了Lapras。与显式CoT相比，Lapras将平均F1提升了高达10.79%，同时生成的标记数量减少了23.9倍。Lapras的连续思考也可以通过标准语言解码解码为可读的推理轨迹，从而保留文本解释。这些结果共同突出了Lapras作为一种高效、有效且可解释的TSLM推理训练后范式的潜力。

articles.title: Clinician use of language models diverges from how the models are evaluated

authors.name: The International Digital Twin Consortium in Healthcare

articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) assistants are being deployed to clinicians across health systems, and judgments about their readiness rest largely on benchmark scores, most of them derived from examination questions or curated cases. A benchmark predicts performance in deployment only to the extent that its items resemble real use, yet whether benchmarks reflect the work these systems receive has rarely been measured. Here we analyze 127,833 queries sent by 6,342 physicians, advanced practice providers and nurses in 35 specialties to an institutional assistant during an eight-month roll-out. We characterize each query with RCQ-Map, a clinician-validated framework grounded in taxonomies of clinical questions and of LLM evaluation, which records its task, intent, answerability, missing information and potential harm. Documentation and administration (36.2%) and knowledge retrieval (28.9%) made up nearly two-thirds of use, and diagnosis 3.7%; more than a third of queries could not be answered well as posed. Applying RCQ-Map to 58 public benchmarks drawn from major evaluation suites and frontier model reports, which we assemble into the Clinical AI Benchmark Atlas, showed that the median benchmark contained no documentation requests and shared 31% of the task mix of real use, less than an even spread across task categories would. Benchmarks in suites designed to resemble clinical practice were individually no closer to real use than those used in frontier model reports. Benchmark scores therefore say little about how clinical AI performs on most of the work it is actually given, and evaluation should be matched to real clinical use.
articles.titleCn: 临床医生使用语言模型的方式与模型被评估的方式存在差异
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）助手正在被部署到医疗系统中的临床医生，对其准备情况的判断主要基于基准分数，这些分数大多来自考试问题或精选案例。基准只有在其项目与实际使用相似的情况下才能预测部署中的表现，然而基准是否反映了这些系统接收的工作却很少被衡量。在此，我们分析了在八个月的推广期间，来自35个专业的6,342名医生、高级实践提供者和护士向机构助手发送的127,833个查询。我们使用RCQ-Map对每个查询进行特征描述，这是一个基于临床问题分类和LLM评估分类的临床医生验证框架，记录了其任务、意图、可回答性、缺失信息和潜在危害。文档和行政工作（36.2%）和知识检索（28.9%）占近三分之二的使用量，诊断占3.7%；超过三分之一的查询无法很好地按原问题回答。将RCQ-Map应用于我们从主要评估套件和前沿模型报告中汇编的58个公共基准（汇编为临床人工智能基准图谱），显示中位数基准不包含文档请求，并且实际使用中的任务组合只有31%与之重叠，远未均匀分布在各任务类别中。旨在模拟临床实践的套件中的基准，与前沿模型报告中使用的基准相比，在接近实际使用方面并无更近。因此，基准分数对于衡量临床人工智能在实际工作中表现甚微，评估应与实际临床使用相匹配。

articles.title: Measuring and Mitigating Solution Mode Collapse in RLVR
articles.abstract: A language model (LM) can usually answer the same question in more than one way, but reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is indifferent to which correct answer a model produces. A solution will earn the same reward whether it is the thousandth copy of a familiar answer or one the model has never produced before. Yet, there is potential value in having the model retain multiple correct solutions as it is trained. For instance, multiple modes may give users a choice and provide problem-solving strategies that improve overall model performance. Here, we introduce ModeBench, a benchmark of multi-solution tasks in which the verifier returns both correctness and mode discovered. We then use ModeBench to measure how solution diversity changes under RLVR post-training. We find that RLVR post-training concentrates probability onto fewer correct modes even as accuracy holds or improves, and moreover, that frontier models are already highly concentrated. We then introduce our solution, Re:Max, which stores one verified example per discovered mode in a replay buffer and trains on those stored modes uniformly. A solution found once is, therefore, practiced as often as one found repeatedly. Across three model scales, two RL objectives, and harder task constructions, replay improves both how often a policy succeeds and how many different ways it can succeed.
articles.titleCn: 测量和缓解RLVR中的解模式崩溃
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型（LM）通常可以用多种方式回答同一个问题，但可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）对模型产生的正确答案并不在意。无论解决方案是某个熟悉答案的千分之一副本，还是模型以前从未产生过的答案，它都会获得相同的奖励。然而，在模型训练过程中保留多个正确解决方案具有潜在价值。例如，多种模式可以为用户提供选择，并提供改进整体模型性能的解题策略。在这里，我们介绍了ModeBench，这是一个多解任务基准，验证者会返回正确性和发现的模式。然后，我们使用ModeBench来衡量RLVR后训练过程中解决方案多样性的变化。我们发现，RLVR后训练将概率集中在更少的正确模式上，即使准确率保持或提高，前沿模型已经高度集中。接着，我们介绍了我们的解决方案Re:Max，它将每个发现的模式的一个验证示例存储在重放缓冲区中，并在这些存储的模式上均匀训练。因此，一旦找到的解决方案会被像反复找到的解决方案一样频繁地练习。在三个模型规模、两个RL目标以及更困难的任务构建中，重放提高了策略成功的频率以及它能够以多少种不同方式成功的数量。

articles.title: FedAlphaEdit: Null-Space-Aligned Merging for Collaborative Knowledge Editing
articles.abstract: Multiple institutions may each hold their own private knowledge edits and wish to integrate them into a single large language model without sharing raw edit requests. Null-space-constrained editing methods such as AlphaEdit mathematically guarantee that each update leaves unrelated knowledge intact, while collaborative frameworks such as CollabEdit aggregate edits from multiple clients without data sharing. Combining the two appears trivial. However, we show that this naive combination fails structurally, and we identify its cause. Guided by this analysis, we propose FedAlphaEdit. To our knowledge, this is the first collaborative knowledge editing framework that aligns both local editing and the server-side merging rule under a single null-space principle for preserving existing knowledge. FedAlphaEdit builds on null-space-aligned merging, in which clients share projected statistics and the server provably recovers the result of editing everything in one place under a one-shot idealization. Empirically, the proposed method repairs the collapse and brings edit success and preservation simultaneously close to the level of centralized editing across two architecture families. FedAlphaEdit thus lets institutions that cannot share raw edit data, such as hospitals and financial firms, jointly maintain a shared model that closely approximates editing all facts in one place.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Includes appendices (proofs, implementation reconciliation, experimental details). Code: https://github.com/soutasuga/FedAlphaEdit
articles.titleCn: FedAlphaEdit：用于协作知识编辑的空空间对齐合并
articles.abstractCn: 多个机构可能各自持有自己的私有知识编辑，并希望将这些编辑整合到一个大型语言模型中，而无需共享原始编辑请求。例如，AlphaEdit这类约束空间的编辑方法从数学上保证了每次更新都能保持无关知识不变，而CollabEdit这类协作框架则在不共享数据的情况下聚合多个客户端的编辑。将两者结合看似简单，然而我们证明这种简单的组合在结构上会失效，并指出了其根本原因。基于这一分析，我们提出了FedAlphaEdit。据我们所知，这是首个在单一约束空间原则下，将本地编辑和服务器端合并规则统一用于保护现有知识的协作知识编辑框架。FedAlphaEdit基于约束空间对齐的合并，其中客户端共享投影统计数据，服务器可证明地恢复在理想化单次操作下对全部内容进行编辑的结果。实证结果表明，该方法修复了崩溃问题，并将编辑成功率和知识保留率同时提升至接近集中式编辑的水平，适用于两种架构系列。因此，FedAlphaEdit使得无法共享原始编辑数据的机构（如医院和金融机构）能够共同维护一个近似于集中式编辑所有事实的共享模型。
